5.name: Alexandra Dhow Cruise in Dubai Marina
5.description:
A Dhow dinner cruise in Dubai Marina is an excellent opportunity to combine sightseeing and a dining experience. Alexandra dhow is the perfect floating restaurant, operating for more than 10 years with a proven track record.

Dubai Marina is in itself a world renowned land mark, and along our sailing route we will see the skyline of JBR, Blue Water Island, Dubai Harbour aswell as Cayan Tower and Ain Dubai.

Onboard you will have a full course dinner with the opportunity to order alcoholic drinks for an extra charge as well as a live entertainment program.
5.terms:
Rules & Regulations

  • Outside food or drinks of any kind not allowed.
  • Smoking is only allowed in designated areas.
  • Alcoholic beverages sold only to 21+

Cancellation Policy

  • Any cancellation for bookings made by credit card will incur a 5% credit card/admin fees.

faq.a:
Dinner Cruise
Boarding at 20:30. Departure at 21:00. Sunset Cruise
17.00 boarding, 1730 departure.

faq.q: Dress code?
faq.a: Dress code is smart casual. In winter, it is desirable to have warm clothes.

faq.q: Greetings for the birthday?
faq.a: At the time of booking the cruise, the birthday boy/girl must be specified. Dessert will be provided at the table with congratulatory music during dinner. A cake can be ordered for an additional fee. To order, please contact our representative.

faq.q: Child Policy?
faq.a:
Children under 5 years old are free (no seating on the bus on the group tour). 
Children 5-12 years old - children's ticket. 
From 12 years old - adult ticket.

faq.q: Is it possible to reserve a certain table in advance?
faq.a: Seats cannot be reserved in advance. There are free seats on arrival on first come first serve basis. We guarantee that every guest will have a seperate table on the deck which he has booked.

235.name: Alexandra Sea Lounge
235.description:
Unwind after a long day in our water lounge. Our spacious double-decker catamaran is the perfect place to enjoy your dinner. Our onboard chef will delight everyone with dishes from international cuisines and his own signature creations.

You will embark on a journey along Dubai's coastline in a luxury floating restaurant, bewitched by the evening lights of the captivating metropolis.

The ship will pass by iconic landmarks such as Dubai Marina - one of the city's most upscale districts, Ain Dubai - the largest Ferris wheel in the world, and the JBR promenade - the city's most popular resort and residential complex.

Brighten up your evening with unique experiences and create memorable photos to reminisce over.
235.terms:
Rate inclusions:

Dinner cruise on a premium catamaran in Dubai Marina (9:00 PM - 10:45 PM)
Entertainment program (live performance by a singer)
Dinner (buffet style), featuring a grill station with an on-board chef.
Non-alcoholic beverages
transportation (if the option with a transportation is selected)
 

Additional Services:

Additional services are available for an extra fee:

Order alcoholic beverages
Order a cake for a special occasion

faq.q: Departure Time?
faq.a: Boarding starts at 8:30 PM. Departure is at 9:00 PM.

faq.q: Dress code?
faq.a: The dress code is smart casual. During the winter season, it's advisable to have warm clothes on hand.

faq.q: Celebrating a special event?
faq.a: When booking a cruise, it's important to notify them if there's someone celebrating a birthday. During dinner, dessert will be served at the table accompanied by celebratory music. For an additional charge, you can order a cake. Please contact our representative to place your order.

faq.q: Child Policy?
faq.a:
Children under the age of 5 for free

In case if sharing basis transportation is needed, kids below 5 can go free although  a separate seat will not be provided for them in the bus. A child's ticket is for children between the ages of 5 and 12. A full adult ticket is required from the age of 12.

faq.a: You won't be able to reserve a specific table, but you can book an upper or lower deck where you'll feel most comfortable.

26.name: 5 Emirates + Indian Ocean Tour (Russian-Speaking Guide)
26.description:
The United Arab Emirates is far more than Dubai's skyline — five emirates apart, each with its own character, unfold within a single day's drive: the cultural heart of Sharjah, the quiet traditions of Ajman and Umm Al Quwain, the rugged mountains of Ras Al Khaimah and the warm shores of the Indian Ocean in Fujairah.

This is a day of contrasts — from a centuries-old mosque and a quiet mangrove coastline to desert dunes rising into rocky peaks, and finally the gentle waves of the East Coast. By evening, you'll have felt the country's full range, far beyond its famous glass towers.

What awaits you

  • Sharjah: a photo stop at the King Faisal Mosque and its landmark square.
  • Ajman: a visit to the Ajman National Museum, housed in an 18th-century fort.
  • Umm Al Quwain: a drive past the mangrove forests of the UAE's quietest emirate.
  • Ras Al Khaimah: a scenic mountain drive from desert dunes to rugged peaks and coastal views.
  • Fujairah & the Indian Ocean: a visit to Al Bidya, the UAE's oldest mosque, followed by free time to swim on the East Coast.

Perfect for

  • First-time visitors: five emirates and the East Coast covered in one comprehensive day trip.
  • Beach and nature lovers: mangrove forests, mountain scenery and a swim in the Indian Ocean.
  • Culture and history enthusiasts: mosques, a national museum and the country's oldest fort in a single itinerary.

faq.a: Smart casual, modest clothing is recommended; closed clothing is required for the museum visit. Bring swimwear, a towel, a hat, sunglasses and sunscreen for the beach stop.

112.name: Abu Dhabi City Tour form Abu Dhabi (Russian-Speaking Guide)
112.description:
Abu Dhabi is a capital where soaring glass towers stand beside centuries-old traditions, and cutting-edge architecture exists in quiet dialogue with deep spiritual roots.

This tour reveals two faces of the city — one shaped by bold ambition and world-class art, the other by timeless faith and craftsmanship — closing with the sight of a dazzling white marble mosque.

What awaits you

  • Louvre Abu Dhabi: masterpieces of world art, unique collections and striking architecture under an iconic dome.
  • Date Market: taste and buy the finest varieties of this traditional delicacy.
  • Abu Dhabi Corniche: a photo stop with panoramic views of the capital's skyline.
  • Qasr Al Watan: the Presidential Palace, with luxurious interiors and grand reception halls.
  • Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque: a majestic white marble mosque, a symbol of spirituality and architectural grandeur.

Perfect for

  • Guests staying in Abu Dhabi: a relaxed afternoon tour covering the capital's main highlights in one trip.
  • Culture and architecture lovers: a world-class museum, a presidential palace and a grand mosque in a single itinerary.
  • Photography lovers: the Corniche skyline, palace interiors and the white marble mosque offer striking contrasts for photos.
112.terms:
What's included:

  • Transport to and from the hotel
  • Russian-speaking guide
  • Entry tickets to attractions (for sharing-basis tours only)

Optional extras:
For an extra charge you can purchase:

  • Traditional women's attire (abaya) for visiting the mosque;
  • Dates and souvenirs during the tour.

faq.q: What is the dress code?
faq.a: Wear smart casual, modest clothing suitable for a museum, palace and mosque. Your clothing should be long — covering the ankles and wrists — non-transparent (not white) and without slits. If you visit the mosque, you should cover your head with a scarf, and any tattoos should be covered as well. Bring something warm, as the bus is air-conditioned.

faq.q: Is a return transfer included?
faq.a: Yes, a return transfer to your hotel is included in the price.

faq.q: Is the abaya included in the price?
faq.a: No, a traditional women's dress (abaya) for visiting the mosque can be purchased for an extra charge.

faq.q: What are the conditions for children?
faq.a: Children under 3 travel free of charge, without a separate seat on group tours. Children aged 3 to 11 inclusive pay a child ticket; from age 12, the adult ticket applies.

7.description:
Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, is where national decisions are made and where sheikhs and billionaires call home — yet its skyline of glass and steel stands beside centuries-old Islamic tradition.

From the hushed marble courtyards of a grand mosque to the buzz of a waterfront promenade, this is a day that reveals two faces of the Emirati capital — its spiritual heart and its bold ambition.

What awaits you

  • Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque: one of the world's most stunning mosques — white marble, intricate mosaics and a serene spiritual atmosphere.
  • Abu Dhabi Corniche: panoramic views of the city and its skyline — a perfect photo spot with the bay as a backdrop.
  • Lunch at an Arabic restaurant: traditional Emirati cuisine in an authentic setting.
  • Louvre Abu Dhabi or Qasr Al Watan (depending on the programme): world-class art collections, or the Presidential Palace's grand ceremonial halls.
  • Date Market: taste and buy the country's finest dates.

Perfect for

  • First-time visitors: the capital's main landmarks covered in a single day.
  • Families: a comfortable, guided tour with lunch included on sharing-basis trips.
  • Culture and architecture lovers: a grand mosque, a world-class museum and a presidential palace in one itinerary.

  • Lunch (buffet) and water (full package if booked on a sharing basis)

Additional services:

  • Purchase dates and souvenirs during the tour.

faq.a: Smart casual and modest — suitable for a museum, palace or mosque. Clothing should be long, reaching the ankles and wrists, non-transparent and without slits. Women should bring a scarf to cover their heads at the mosque, and any tattoos should also be covered. Bring something warm, as the bus is air-conditioned.

faq.q: What are the conditions for visiting with children?
faq.a: Children under 3 travel free of charge, without a separate seat on group tours. Children aged 3 to 11 inclusive pay a child ticket; from age 12, the adult ticket applies.

faq.q: Is the abaya included in the price?

20.name: AYA Universe Dubai
20.description:
Don’t miss Dubai’s viral immersive sensation!

AYA is an out-of-this-world experience that transports guests to a beautiful and mysterious star in a distant galaxy.

Wander through 12 gorgeous worlds that reveal infinite star fields, reverse waterfalls, glittering gardens, and rare cosmic spectacles.

Explore, connect, and create with friends and family on an unforgettable journey and discover AYA’s secrets for yourself!

 

Highlights:

  • Each of AYA’s 12 worlds explores a different cosmic spectacle of impossible beauty.
  • Spark life across the universe in the Source.
  • Dance with light across infinite dimensions in Harmonia.
  • Float and travel through the hearts of stars in Drift.
  • Witness a cosmic storm in a glittering garden in Flora.
  • Command infinite waves of color in Tides.
  • Transport to another dimension in Luna.
  • Home to the largest immersive ball pit in Dubai, offering fun for all ages.
  • Infinity mirror rooms.
  • Waterfalls running in reverse in the Falls.
  • Explore holographic depths in The Pool.
  • Play with mysterious creatures in Outland.
  • Cross paths of power in The River.
20.terms:
• The ticket includes access to all 12 immersive zones within the park.
  • Free admission for people of determination.
  • The ticket is valid for 30 days from the date of purchase.
  • No food or drinks are allowed inside the park.
  • Professional cameras are not allowed.

faq.q: WHAT IS AYA UNIVERSE?
faq.a: Aya Universe is an immersive entertainment park located in Dubai, offering a unique experience that blends art, technology, and nature. It’s a sanctuary beyond our known universe, where visitors can explore vibrant worlds and engage with the natural beauty of a mysterious cosmos.

faq.q: WHERE IS AYA UNIVERSE LOCATED?
faq.a: Aya Universe is located on the first floor of WAFI Mall, Oud Metha Road, Dubai, UAE. It’s easily accessible by car and public transport, with parking options available​.

faq.q: WHAT ARE THE OPENING HOURS OF AYA UNIVERSE?
faq.a: Aya Universe is open Sunday to Thursday from 10 AM to 10 PM, and Friday to Saturday from 10 AM to 12 AM. The last entry is allowed one hour before closing​​.

faq.q: ARE THERE ANY AGE RESTRICTIONS FOR VISITORS?
faq.a: Aya Universe welcomes visitors of all ages. However, some exhibits may have age or height restrictions for safety purposes. Please check specific exhibit details for more information.

faq.q: IS AYA UNIVERSE ACCESSIBLE TO PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES?
faq.a: Yes, Aya Universe is designed to be accessible to all our visitors. If you have specific accessibility needs, please contact us in advance so we can assist you.

faq.q: CAN I BRING MY OWN FOOD AND DRINKS TO AYA UNIVERSE?
faq.a: Visitors are advised to not bring outside food and drinks into Aya Universe. There is a variety of dining options available within the park.

faq.q: IS PHOTOGRAPHY ALLOWED IN AYA UNIVERSE?
faq.a: Yes, photography is allowed, and visitors are encouraged to capture their memorable moments. However, commercial photography may require prior permission.

Children under 3 years old do not need a ticket.

  • Dates: July 16, 30 | August 13, 27

136.name: Burj Khalifa - At The Top
136.description:
Burj Khalifa is the tallest building in the world at 828 metres and the main symbol of Dubai. Its silhouette, inspired by the hymenocallis flower, combines bold engineering with motifs of traditional Islamic architecture.

Seen from above, the city opens up anew: by day, a scattering of skyscrapers and the line of the coast; at sunset, the gold of the desert giving way to the evening lights of the metropolis. Three levels of observation decks let you choose the scale of the experience — from the classic panorama to an exclusive lounge above the clouds.

What Awaits You

  • Silver, levels 124 and 125: observation decks at a height of 456 metres with the finest panoramas of the city.
  • Gold, level 148: an observation deck one level higher, with breathtaking views.
  • Platinum, levels 152–154: the highest lounge in the world at a height of 585 metres, with a cup of coffee or tea.

Ideal For

  • A first acquaintance with Dubai: the key stop on the itinerary of every visitor to the emirate.
  • Photography lovers: sunrise, sunset or the evening illuminations of the city from a bird’s-eye view.
  • Special occasions: a cup of coffee or tea in the world’s highest lounge on the Platinum level.
136.terms:
Included in the price:

  • Entry ticket to the Burj Khalifa observation deck (according to the category booked — Silver, Gold or Platinum)

Additional services:
For an extra charge you may:

  • Book a private transfer or guided tour
  • Purchase photographs and souvenirs

faq.q: What is the dress code?
faq.a: The dress code is casual; clothing must not be see-through.

faq.q: What are the conditions for children?
faq.a: Children under 3 go free. From 3 to 7 years inclusive — child ticket; from 8 years — adult ticket. Proof of the child’s age may be requested at the check-in desk. Pushchairs are not permitted in the lift and remain at the base of the tower until the end of the visit.

faq.q: How long does the visit take?
faq.a: The visit usually takes from 1.5 to 2 hours, depending on the number of visitors.

faq.q: How do I find the check-in desk?
faq.a: The Burj Khalifa check-in desk is located on the LG (Lower Ground) level of Dubai Mall — follow the signs for “At the Top”.

faq.q: Do I need to print my ticket?
faq.a: No, both printed and electronic tickets are accepted.

faq.q: What documents are required for entry?
faq.a: Please bring photo identification and your ticket (printed or electronic).

faq.q: What should I do if I am late?
faq.a: Speak to the staff at the check-in desk — the Burj Khalifa management will decide whether you may be admitted. If entry is refused, no refund is provided and a new ticket must be purchased.

faq.q: May I bring my own food and drinks?
faq.a: No, food and drinks may not be taken onto the observation deck.

183.name: Cabrio Tour
183.description:
Dubai's skyline is a study in contrast — glass towers rising where desert once stretched to the horizon, framed by palm-lined boulevards and the shimmer of the Persian Gulf.

Riding through the city with the top down, wind in your hair, the skyline unfolds like a scene from a movie — sleek towers flashing past, the road opening up, a sense of freedom you won't find on a standard bus tour.

What to expect

  • Private convertible: a stylish Chevrolet Camaro (or similar) with your own driver — sit back and enjoy the ride.
  • Dubai's icons: a drive past futuristic skyscrapers, world-famous landmarks and upscale districts.
  • Photo stops: capture striking shots against Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah and other symbols of the city.
  • Open-air freedom: wind in your hair, panoramic views and a cinematic mood.
  • Flexible route: the driver can take you on any route of your choice within the city.

Perfect for

  • Couples: a romantic ride to mark a special occasion.
  • Photography enthusiasts: cinematic photos against the city's most iconic backdrops.
  • Anyone seeking a touch of luxury: a memorable, stylish way to see Dubai away from the standard tour bus.

4.description:
Fishing is an integral part of the culture and everyday life of local residents, as the Persian Gulf is rich in various types of fish, such as: barracuda, sea bass, tuna, and cobia. 
Accompanied by an experienced crew, you will embark on a comfortable boat and cruise the waters of the Persian Gulf. Fishing takes place on high-speed boats equipped with all the necessary equipment for bottom fishing, trolling, and spinning. 

Whether you are an experienced angler or a novice, the thrill of the catch and a great mood will always be with you.

109.name: House of Hype
109.description:
House of Hype is a revolutionary art space in Dubai that combines fashion, digital art, music, and immersive technologies.

Here, the boundaries between the virtual and real worlds blur, and guests can not only see unique digital installations but also become part of interactive exhibitions.

House of Hype unites art, style, and technology, turning a visit into a multi-layered visual and auditory journey.

It is a place for everyone who wants to experience cutting-edge technologies, participate in exclusive events, and immerse themselves in a world of innovation. 

Main Areas and Exhibitions 

  • Immersive Art Installations – Digital and interactive galleries featuring augmented and virtual reality elements.
  • Fashion & Streetwear Zone – A space that combines art and fashion, showcasing exclusive designer collections.
  • Multimedia Exhibitions – An immersion into digital reality, where art comes alive through LED screens and projections.
  • Cafes and Lounge Areas – A place to relax, enjoy drinks, and light snacks.

faq.q: Сколько достопримечательностей в House Of Hype?
faq.a: House of Hype — идеальное место для незабываемых захватывающих приключений в Дубае. Этот парк развлечений, занимающий впечатляющую площадь в 100 000 квадратных футов, предлагает более 100 уникальных, необычных развлечений, расположенных в самом посещаемом месте в мире — торговом центре Dubai Mall.

faq.q: Является ли House Of Hype крытым аттракционом?
faq.a: Да, House Of Hype — это крытый аттракцион с кондиционером, что делает его идеальным для всех желающих круглый год.

708.name: Modern Dubai City Tour with Cruise from Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah (Russian-Speaking Guide)
708.description:
Dubai is a city where futuristic ambition and Eastern tradition exist side by side — glass towers rise beside sail-shaped icons born from Bedouin heritage.

This is a city that keeps reinventing itself: by day it dazzles with record-breaking skylines, by night it glows with fountains and lights reflected on the water.

What awaits you

  • Museum of the Future: a photo stop at the striking torus-shaped building that has become Dubai's newest symbol.
  • Burj Al Arab: a view of the legendary hotel rising against the sea.
  • Palm Jumeirah: a monorail ride across the man-made island with panoramic views of the coastline and skyscrapers.
  • Dubai Marina: cruise aboard a traditional dhow boat, with a meal served on board.
  • The Dubai Mall & singing fountains: the giant aquarium and an evening fountain show at the foot of Burj Khalifa.

Perfect for

  • First-time visitors: the city's main landmarks covered in a single day without planning your own route.
  • Families: a comfortable air-conditioned bus and an easy pace suited to guests of any age.
  • Photography lovers: the contrast between the futuristic skyline, the sail of Burj Al Arab and the marina lit up at sunset.

3.name: Modern Dubai City Tour with Sightseeing Cruise (Russian-Speaking Guide)
3.description:
Dubai is a city of the future, born from the desert in just a few decades — yet its glass towers and futuristic skyline still make room for Eastern charm and tradition.

This tour reveals Dubai's many faces: bold and ambitious by day, glowing with light by night, where ultramodern architecture and old Arabian atmosphere exist side by side.

What awaits you

  • Dubai Marina: a scenic boat cruise along the canal, past a wall of skyscrapers and yacht-lined docks.
  • Palm Jumeirah: a monorail ride over the man-made island, with views of the Atlantis Hotel, waterfront villas and the Persian Gulf.
  • Burj Al Arab: a photo stop at the sail-shaped hotel, the emirate's most iconic landmark.
  • Madinat Jumeirah: canals, wooden bridges and a covered souk in the style of an old Arabian town.
  • The Dubai Mall & singing fountains: a giant aquarium, an evening fountain show and views of the Burj Khalifa.

Perfect for

  • First-time visitors: all of Dubai's main landmarks in a single day, without planning your own route.
  • Families with children: a comfortable air-conditioned bus and an easy pace suited to all ages.
  • Photography enthusiasts: from the skyline of the Marina to the canals of Madinat Jumeirah and the illuminated fountains at night.

6.name: Night Dubai city tour with dinner cruise (Russian-Speaking Guide)
6.description:
Dubai after dark reveals its dual soul: neon-lit towers rise above century-old wind-tower houses, and narrow lanes of the old town give way to sweeping views over a futuristic skyline.

This evening tour captures that contrast in motion — the quiet charm of old Dubai fading into the sparkle of the modern city, its lights reflected in the water as the sun goes down.

What to expect

  • Al Seef: a stroll along the historic waterfront — authentic houses, wind towers and narrow lanes recreating old Dubai.
  • Burj Al Arab: a photo stop beside the sail-shaped hotel, one of Dubai's most recognizable landmarks.
  • Palm Jumeirah: a visit to The View at The Palm observation deck, 240 metres above the island.
  • Dubai Marina: an evening dhow cruise with a buffet dinner, drinks and on-board entertainment, skyscraper lights reflected in the water.

Perfect for

  • First-time visitors: the city's evening highlights in one relaxed tour, with no need to plan the route yourself.
  • Families: a comfortable, guided evening outing suitable for guests of any age.
  • Couples and photography enthusiasts: romantic views and the glittering night skyline, best captured from the water.

709.name: Two Pearls of the East – Abu Dhabi + Dubai
709.description:
Abu Dhabi and Dubai are two emirates with very different characters: one keeps its spiritual heritage in white marble, the other shines with glass towers and man-made islands. Together they form a portrait of the modern UAE built on contrast.

The day opens with the quiet of marble halls and the sea breeze of the capital’s waterfront, then picks up pace towards evening: the city reveals itself first from the water, then from above, and closes the day with music, light and water.

What awaits you

  • Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque: a white marble masterpiece, one of the most beautiful mosques in the world.
  • Abu Dhabi waterfront: a walk along the Corniche with views of the bay and the capital’s skyline.
  • Traditional dhow cruise: an hour on the water with lunch on board, past the line of skyscrapers.
  • Museum of the Future: a photo stop at the ring-shaped building with Arabic calligraphy across its facade.
  • Sky Views observation deck: a panorama of central Dubai from over 200 metres up, with a glass bridge above the city streets.
  • Dubai Mall and the Fountain Show: free time in the world’s largest shopping mall and the evening water show at the foot of Burj Khalifa.

Perfect for

  • First-time visitors to the UAE: two emirates, Abu Dhabi and Dubai, in one packed day with no logistics to plan yourself.
  • Families with children: a cruise with lunch, a comfortable pace and an evening fountain show suit guests of any age.
  • Lovers of panoramas and photography: the white marble of the mosque, views from the water, the Museum of the Future and an observation deck above central Dubai.

faq.a: The programme runs from 9:00 to 20:00.

faq.a: Wear casual, closed, non-transparent clothing that covers you to the ankles and wrists, without slits, and not white. Women should bring a scarf to cover their heads when visiting the mosque, and any tattoos should be covered as well. Bring something warm with you: the bus is air-conditioned.

faq.q: Is the abaya included in the price?
faq.a: No, the traditional women’s dress (abaya) for visiting the mosque can be purchased for an extra charge.

faq.q: Is a return transfer included?
faq.a: Yes, a return transfer is included in the price and departs from Dubai Mall. If you decide to stay in the mall or leave earlier, please tell your guide in advance.

faq.a: Children under 3 years old travel free of charge, without a separate seat on group tours. From 3 to 11 years old inclusive, a child ticket applies, and from 12 years old, the adult ticket applies.

What awaits you

  • Theme parks (choose 2): MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, Real Madrid World, LEGOLAND® Dubai, LEGOLAND® Water Park and Oasis Bay (coming soon).
  • City attractions (choose 1): The Green Planet, The View at The Palm or Ain Dubai (coming soon).
  • Flex Experience (choose 1): Global Village or the Riverland™ Dubai Standard Package - Riverland™ Standard Package: full-day entry to Riverland, Axe Throwing (18+, 5 throws), Archery (10+, 5 arrows), Perplex City (15 minutes), Neon Galaxy (1 hour) and Leisure Cycling (1 hour).

Perfect for

  • Travellers who like to plan their own time: 10 days to visit the attractions in any order you like.

144.name: Aquarium and Underwater Zoo at the Dubai Mall
144.description:
Iconic Attraction
Get ready to dive into an underwater world like no other at The Dubai Mall Aquarium, one of the most spectacular and awe-inspiring attractions in Dubai.

With its massive size and diverse collection of marine life, the aquarium offers a unique opportunity to get up close and personal with some of the most fascinating creatures of the ocean.

Walk through a 48-meter-long tunnel and gaze in amazement at
over 140 species of sea creatures including sharks, rays, and giant groupers swimming above and around you.

Animal Interaction Packages
The aquarium also features a stunning underwater zoo, where visitors can watch penguins, otters, and other aquatic animals in their natural habitats.

For the more adventurous, The Dubai Mall Aquarium offers a range of exciting experiences such as cage snorkeling, shark dives, and glass-bottom boat rides that will take you on a thrilling journey through the depths of the ocean.

With its world-class facilities and unparalleled experiences, The Dubai Mall Aquarium is a must-visit attraction for marine life enthusiasts and families alike.

142.name: Aquaventure World Waterpark
142.description:
Aquaventure World at Atlantis The Palm in Dubai is one of the most iconic and expansive waterparks in the world, offering unforgettable experiences for both kids and adults. Spanning over 22 hectares, the park features an impressive variety of rides, attractions, and relaxing spaces — all themed around the lost city of Atlantis.

The waterpark is home to Trident Tower, Poseidon’s Tower, and Neptune’s Tower, each packed with record-breaking slides, wave pools, and rafting rides. Adrenaline seekers can try Leap of Faith, a near-vertical slide that sends you speeding through a clear tube surrounded by sharks. Families will love Splashers Lagoon and Cove, specially designed water playgrounds for younger children.

One of the park’s highlights is the Lost World Aquarium, a fascinating underwater world inspired by the ruins of Atlantis. Visitors can explore over 65,000 marine animals, including sharks, rays, and vibrant reef fish, in immersive tunnels and interactive exhibits.

The lush surroundings of the park are filled with palm trees, tropical flowers, and scenic lagoons. Guests also enjoy exclusive access to a private beach, where they can relax on the white sands with views of the Arabian Gulf.

Combining thrilling adventures with moments of serenity, Aquaventure is a must-visit for anyone seeking fun, discovery, and water-filled excitement in Dubai.

faq.q: What are the hours of operation?
faq.a: The waterpark is open from 10.00 am to 18.30 pm. Please note the closing time of the park is not fixed and is based on the sunset timing, and we request you to double check the park timings before visiting the park.

For the little ones, there is a special play and swimming area called Splashers Island and Lagoon. All young children must wear armbands and swim diapers.

217.name: Buggy & Quad Bike Safari in Dubai
217.description:
Experience the thrill of adventure with a memorable buggy and quad tour in Dubai’s stunning desert landscapes. Starting from Badayer, renowned worldwide for its striking red sands, this tour promises an exhilarating journey through some of the most beautiful and expansive desert scenery in the world.

These big dunes provide the perfect playground for thrill-seekers eager to conquer the sands. As you venture into the desert, you'll be greeted by the breathtaking view of endless golden waves, creating a picture-perfect backdrop for an adventure-filled day.

The tour offers a self-drive experience, allowing you to take control of powerful and comfortable vehicles.

You can choose from one, two and four seater buggies. These robust vehicles are designed to handle the challenging terrain with ease, providing a safe yet exciting ride as you navigate the dunes. The buggies are perfect for those who want to feel the adrenaline rush of driving through the desert in their own hands.

Quad bikes are also available, with Yamaha 350cc models that are easy to handle and perfect for solo riders or those who want to experience the desert on their own. Quad biking adds a different dimension to the adventure, offering agility and a closer connection to the terrain.

Throughout the tour, you'll be guided by an experienced professional who ensures your safety and enhances your experience. The guide will take you through the beautiful desert terrain, sharing safety tips to make your ride enjoyable and secure. The guide's expertise allows you to focus on the thrill of the ride while ensuring you navigate the dunes confidently.

This desert tour is more than just an adrenaline rush; it’s a chance to connect with nature's raw beauty. The vibrant red sands, endless dunes, and clear desert skies create a setting that’s both awe-inspiring and peaceful. Whether you're a thrill-seeker or someone seeking a scenic escape, this buggy and quad tour provides an unmatched adventure experience in Dubai’s desert.
217.terms: The price includes the buggy adventure and guided tour. Pregnant women are strictly not allowed to participate. Additional fees apply for alcoholic drinks, sheesha, ATV or buggy rental, and souvenirs.

faq.q: What is the dress code?
faq.a: Comfortable sportswear is recommended. Sport shoes or flip-flops. Warm clothes are recommended during winter.

faq.q: What is the child policy?

2640.name: Classic Dubai City Tour with Spanish Tour Guide
2640.description:
Discover the charm of Dubai on a half-day guided tour in Spanish, combining the city’s rich heritage with its iconic modern landmarks.

Begin your journey in the historic Al Bastakiya district, where traditional houses and elegant wind towers offer a glimpse into Dubai’s past. Continue with a scenic Abra boat ride across Dubai Creek, followed by a visit to the vibrant Gold and Spice Souks, where you can explore the city’s traditional markets and experience their unique atmosphere.

Next, head to the beautiful Jumeirah area for memorable photo stops at the stunning Jumeirah Mosque and the world-famous Burj Al Arab. Conclude your tour with a panoramic drive along Sheikh Zayed Road, admiring Dubai’s impressive skyline and the magnificent Burj Khalifa.

After an unforgettable introduction to the city, return to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the evening at your leisure.

  • Traditional Abra boat ride across Dubai Creek

faq.a: Smart casual attire is recommended. Please wear modest, comfortable clothing that provides adequate coverage and is not transparent, in keeping with local customs.

faq.a: We recommend bringing cash or a bank card to cover personal expenses and souvenir purchases during the tour.

faq.a: Yes, the traditional Abra boat ride across Dubai Creek is included in the tour price.

faq.q: Is the return transfer to the hotel included?
faq.a: Yes, the return transfer to your hotel is included in the tour price. If you wish to spend more time at Dubai Mall or return earlier, please inform your tour guide in advance. Please note that alternative return arrangements will be at your own expense.

itinerary.desc: The Spice Souk is a vibrant traditional market filled with aromatic spices, herbs, dried fruits, and local delicacies, offering a sensory journey into Dubai’s rich trading heritage and authentic Arabian culture.

itinerary.desc: Jumeirah Mosque is one of Dubai’s most iconic landmarks, renowned for its elegant Islamic architecture, magnificent domes, and graceful minarets.

itinerary.desc: The Burj Al Arab is one of Dubai’s most iconic landmarks, renowned for its spectacular sail-shaped design and stunning location overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

2647.name: Conservation Drive & Breakfast at Al Maha
2647.description:
A quiet, private morning in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve. Your Conservation Guide collects you in a luxurious Land Rover Defender and drives you deep into the reserve, explaining how the desert plants and animals survive and how the area is protected.

You stop at a remote lake that attracts migratory birds, look for oryx and gazelles, and then arrive at the world-famous Al Maha Desert Resort & Spa for a gourmet breakfast on the deck, with the dunes and grazing wildlife in front of you. The car is air-conditioned, so the tour is comfortable all year round.

What to expect

  • Private Land Rover Defender: door-to-door in Dubai, with your own Conservation Guide.
  • Nature drive: 60 minutes through the reserve, with stories about fauna, flora and conservation.
  • Remote lake: a peaceful stop at a lake visited by migratory birds.
  • Wildlife: a good chance to see Arabian oryx and gazelles.
  • Breakfast at Al Maha: a chef's breakfast menu inspired by water, earth, fire and air, with eggs your way.

Perfect for

  • Couples: a private, romantic morning with a five-star breakfast.
  • Nature lovers and photographers: soft morning light, wildlife and wide desert views.
  • Guests who do not like dune bashing: a calm, comfortable drive all year round.
2647.terms:
What's included:

  • Private hotel pick-up and drop-off in Dubai in an air-conditioned Land Rover Defender
  • Private Conservation Guide
  • Headscarf and stainless steel water bottle to keep
  • 60-minute nature drive in the reserve
  • Gourmet breakfast at Al Maha Desert Resort & Spa

Not included:

Optional extras:

faq.a: Yes. The Land Rover Defender, the guide and the breakfast table are only for your group.

faq.a: Every day, all year round. The car is air-conditioned.

faq.q: Will we see wildlife?
faq.a: Often. Arabian oryx and gazelles live in the reserve and graze near Al Maha.

faq.q: What should I wear?
faq.a: Light, comfortable clothes, a hat, sunglasses and sunscreen. From November to March bring a warm layer for the evening and the early morning.

faq.q: Who should not join the nature drive?
faq.a: The drive is not recommended for guests who are more than six months pregnant.

faq.q: Can you cater for special diets?
faq.a: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and kosher-style meals are possible. Tell us about diets and allergies when you book.

146.name: Deep Dive Dubai
146.description:
Deep Dive Dubai is a unique diving pool in Dubai, unparalleled anywhere in the world. Located in the modern Nad Al Sheba district, this facility is recognized as the deepest diving pool on the planet, with an astonishing depth of 60 meters.

Deep Dive Dubai offers more than just classic diving — it opens up an entire underwater world with numerous themed zones, including a sunken "city," a car, street decorations, and even a library and arcade machines, creating the illusion of a true adventure in an underwater reality.

The pool is equipped with state-of-the-art technology, featuring advanced water filtration systems and over 50 surveillance cameras to ensure maximum safety for divers of all skill levels — from beginners to professionals.

This is a place where anyone can experience the incredible sensations of diving into another world, without leaving the city, in a comfortable and fully controlled environment.

225.name: Deep Sea Fishing in Abu Dhabi
225.description: Experience the thrill and excitement of deep sea fishing in Abu Dhabi with our exclusive fishing tour. Our fully equipped fishing boat, 'Alpha,' is parked in Marina Mall, Abu Dhabi, ready to take you on an unforgettable fishing adventure. With our experienced captain and a maximum of 6 guests per trip, you'll have a personalized and customer-oriented experience. As you set sail, get ready to catch a variety of fish including barracuda, grouper, sharrie, sultan ibrahim, queen fish, and king fish. Our Instagram page, @fishinguae, showcases the incredible catches from our previous trips. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced angler, our crew will adapt to your needs and provide all the necessary fishing equipment. During the trip, you have the option to release the fish or take them with you. If you choose to keep the fish, our staff can clean it for you or guide you to nearby restaurants that can prepare it according to your preferences. We even have a small gas BBQ onboard if you prefer to cook the fish right onboard. Your safety is our top priority, and we comply with all government requirements. Our captains are experienced in handling any situation, and we will cancel a trip if the weather conditions are not safe. The trip includes social distancing measures, sanitization protocols, temperature checks, and mask-wearing by our staff. Don't miss the opportunity to escape the city stress and enjoy the calm waters of Abu Dhabi while fishing. Book your private deep sea fishing trip today and create unforgettable memories with your friends and family.
225.terms: The price includes a private, fully equipped boat, experienced captain, necessary fishing equipment, water, soft drinks, and icebox. The trip duration is 4 hours, with the option to extend for an additional fee. Prices include VAT, and transfers are only possible from Dubai. Food is not included in the trip.

faq.q: Where do the tours begin and end?
faq.a: Unless you purchase the transfer package, you will need to come to Marina Mall to board the boat.

faq.q: What level of experience is required?
faq.a: Any level of experience is welcome. Our crew will adapt to match your needs, whether you're a beginner or an experienced angler.

faq.q: What do we do with the fish we catch?
faq.a: You can choose to release the fish, take them with you, have our staff clean them for an extra charge, or go to a nearby restaurant to have them prepared.

faq.q: How safe is it? Is it suitable for kids?
faq.a: We comply with all government requirements and prioritize safety. Our captains are experienced in handling situations. It is a relatively safe experience, and many kids enjoy it.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring any food or drinks you wish to have onboard.

311.name: Desert Safari + Al Faqaa Camp
311.description:
Enjoy an unforgettable evening in the Arabian desert with a classic desert safari experience. Leave the city behind and travel into the golden dunes for an exciting off-road adventure, beautiful sunset views, and a relaxing evening at a traditional desert camp.

Your journey begins with pickup from your hotel, followed by a thrilling dune drive across the desert in a comfortable 4x4 vehicle. Along the way, you will have time to stop for photos and take in the peaceful beauty of the desert landscape. Guests may also get the chance to try sandboarding on the dunes.

After the desert drive, continue to a welcoming safari camp where you can relax in a traditional setting with cushions, carpets, and a central stage. Enjoy a short camel ride, try henna painting, take photos in local-style dress, or simply unwind as the evening atmosphere builds.

As night falls, a buffet dinner with BBQ and soft drinks will be served. The evening continues with live entertainment, which may include Tanoura dance, belly dance, and a fire show. This experience is a perfect mix of adventure, culture, dining, and entertainment, making it one of the most popular activities for visitors and residents in the UAE.

faq.q: What should I wear for the desert safari?
faq.a: Comfortable casual or sportswear is recommended. Guests may wear sports shoes, sandals, or flip-flops. During the winter season, it is advisable to bring a light jacket or warm clothing, as the desert can become cool in the evening.

faq.q: What is the child policy?
faq.a: Children below 2 years old are not permitted on this tour. Children from 2 to 12 years old are usually eligible for a child rate, while guests aged 12 years and above are considered adults. Young children may not be suitable for dune bashing due to the nature of the activity.

faq.q: Can I drive the 4x4 vehicle myself?
faq.a: No, guests are not allowed to drive the safari 4x4 vehicle. The dune drive is conducted by experienced drivers. Guests who want a self-drive desert experience may choose to rent a buggy, subject to availability and extra charges.

faq.q: Can I rent a quad bike or buggy during the tour?
faq.a: Yes, quad bikes and buggies may be available for rent during the stop at the desert meeting point. These activities are optional and are charged separately.

faq.q: Is hotel drop-off included?
faq.a: Yes, return transportation is included. After the dinner and live entertainment, guests will be dropped back to their hotel or designated pickup location.

faq.q: Why are some desert safari options cheaper?
faq.a: Desert safari experiences can vary depending on the supplier, camp quality, dune location, vehicle standards, food, entertainment, and overall service level. Cheaper options may use different desert areas or offer a more basic experience. A quality safari usually includes licensed drivers, proper safety standards, a comfortable camp, good food, and reliable service.

faq.q: Is dune bashing suitable for everyone?
faq.a: Dune bashing is not recommended for guests with medical conditions, back or neck problems, heart issues, or for very young children. Pregnant women are not allowed to participate in this tour due to safety restrictions.

faq.q: What is included in the desert safari?
faq.a: The experience usually includes dune bashing, a photo stop in the desert, a short camel ride, buffet dinner with soft drinks, and live entertainment such as belly dance, Tanoura dance, and fire show.

faq.q: Are there any optional extras?
faq.a: Yes, optional extras may include alcoholic drinks, shisha, ATV or buggy rental, and souvenirs. These are not included in the standard package and can be purchased separately.

45.name: Desert Safari in Abu Dhabi
45.description:
Experience the unparalleled beauty and wonder of the Arabian desert with our exclusive evening safari in Abu Dhabi. As the sun starts its descent, you'll be whisked away in a powerful 4WD vehicle, feeling the adrenaline rush as you glide and weave over golden sand dunes. 

Marvel at the majesty of nature as you stop by a thriving camel farm, where you can observe these gentle giants of the desert in their natural habitat. Gain insight into their significance in the history and culture of the region.

Upon arriving at a traditionally-styled desert camp, you'll be enveloped in the rich tapestry of Arabic culture. Here, you can partake in exhilarating activities such as quad biking, which lets you commandeer your own vehicle over the dunes, or sandboarding, a thrill akin to snowboarding but on the smooth desert sands. For a more serene experience, mount a camel and ride it, feeling its rhythmic gait beneath you as you traverse the desert landscape.

After your adventures, take a moment to dress in authentic Arabic attire. With the setting sun casting golden hues around you, it's the perfect backdrop for a memorable photo shoot. 

As evening deepens, allow your senses to be captivated. Witness the sun painting the vast sky in shades of amber and crimson as it sets, turning the desert into a canvas of breathtaking beauty. The aroma of a sumptuous BBQ buffet dinner will tantalize your senses, offering a delectable range of local and international dishes. 

But the night isn’t over yet. As you dine under the canopy of a starlit sky, you'll be entertained with live performances that capture the soul of Arabic art and culture. Whether it's the mesmerizing swirls of a belly dancer or the haunting melodies of traditional music, you'll be completely immersed in the enchanting ambiance.

Join us for a night that promises not only excitement and adventure but also a deep dive into the rich tapestry of the Arabic desert legacy. An evening you'll reminisce about for years to come awaits you.
45.terms:
Guests are recommended to wear comfortable attire suitable for a desert environment. Respect the local customs and regulations, especially when participating in traditional activities. Ensure you carry necessary essentials for an evening outing.

Dune bashing is not recommended for persons with medical conditions and young children below 3.

Pregnant women are STRICTLY not allowed to participate in this tour by LAW. If you have purchase this ticket and are pregnant you will be denied service.

faq.q: How long is the evening safari?
faq.a: The evening safari lasts for approximately 5-6 hours.

faq.q: Is there an opportunity to ride a camel?
faq.a: Yes, camel riding is one of the activities included in the safari.

faq.q: Is the BBQ dinner vegetarian-friendly?
faq.a: Yes, there are vegetarian options available in the BBQ buffet dinner.

faq.q: Will I get picked up from the hotel?
faq.a: Yes, you will be picked up and dropped to the hotel?

faq.q: What is NOT included?
faq.a: For the evening safari, the only optionals are dune buggies, quad bikes, sheesha, alcoholic beverages, souvenirs and tips. All of the above is optional.

159.name: Desert Safari in Dubai + Noble Safari Camp
159.description:
We invite you to get away from the noisy metropolis to the amazing, alluring desert, where the crests of picturesque dunes can be seen in the gentle rays of the velvet sunset.

Specially equipped jeeps with roaring engines will drive you through waves of huge sand dunes into the heart of the desert, where the serene spirit of golden sands reigns.

After a thrilling jeep ride we will find ourselves in a comfortable premium desert camp where you will have dinner and a whole host of live performances.

The noble safari camp is considered one of the best desert camps in the UAE with a #1 or #2 spot in the TripAdvisor rankings. The camp is known for its unique decor, a huge entertainment program featuring oud players, singers, multiple belly dancers, fire show and much more.

30.name: Desert Safari in Dubai + Red Sands Camp
30.description:
Dune Bashing

Experience a real Arabian adventure on a desert safari tour. 

Get on a breathtaking ride in the desert, crossing dunes in a comfortable off-road vehicle, like a real world roller coaster - informally known as 'dune bashing'.

During the safari you will have an opportunity to take stunning pictures of the unmistakable desert beauty as well as try out sand boarding in the steep red dunes.

Desert Camp

After the madness of the dune bashing you will arrive at a desert camp where you will be offered comfortable pillows & cushions to sit on with a stage in the middle of the camp.

At the camp you will be served a full course buffet dinner with live bbq as well as a bar and sheesha station available for extra charge.

The cherry on the cake will be a 3 set live entertainment program consisting of a tanura dance show, belly dance show and a fire show.

Additionally, you will be able to dress in local attire for some exciting photo opportunities and also get 'henna' temporary tatoos that are very common amongst women in the gulf.

The desert safari is a must try tour in the UAE for residents and visitors alike.

36.name: Desert Safari in Ras Al-Khaimah & Fujeirah
36.description: Experience the magic of the Arabian desert with our Evening Safari in Ras Al-Khaimah. This thrilling tour takes you on a journey through the stunning dunes of RAK, where you'll witness the beauty of the desert landscape and immerse yourself in the rich culture of the region. Your adventure begins with a pick-up from your hotel in RAK, where you'll be transported to the desert in a comfortable vehicle. As you arrive at the dunes, get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience of dune bashing. Hold on tight as your skilled driver navigates the sandy terrain, taking you on a thrilling ride over the golden dunes. After the exhilarating dune bashing, you'll have the opportunity to capture the breathtaking sunset views with a photo stop. Watch as the sun paints the sky in vibrant hues, creating a stunning backdrop for your pictures. Next, you'll be taken to a traditional desert camp, where you can indulge in a range of exciting activities. Take a short camel ride and experience the gentle sway of these magnificent creatures as you explore the desert. Try your hand at sandboarding, a thrilling sport that allows you to glide down the dunes on a board, or rent an ATV or buggy for an exhilarating ride. As the evening sets in, feast on a delicious BBQ dinner under the starlit sky. Indulge in a variety of local and international dishes, and savor the flavors of the region. While you dine, be entertained by live performances that showcase the vibrant culture of the Arabian desert. From mesmerizing belly dancers to traditional music, you'll be captivated by the enchanting ambiance. After an unforgettable evening, you'll be transferred back to your hotel, with memories that will last a lifetime. Join us for an Evening Safari in Ras Al-Khaimah and experience the beauty and excitement of the Arabian desert.

66.name: Dinner in the Sky
66.description:
Dinner in the Sky in Dubai is a unique gastronomic experience, characterized not only by exquisite dishes but also by its exceptional setting. It takes place on a specially suspended platform, located 50 meters above the ground, equipped with everything necessary for an enjoyable and safe experience.


Dinner in the Sky - is the most panoramic restaurant in the city, where there are no barriers between you and the breathtaking views of the sparkling azure waters of the bay and the metropolis, with its towering facades of modern architectural giants.


The restaurant "Dinner in the Sky" has rightfully earned its reputation as one of the most unique establishments. It has been listed in the top 10 of Forbes magazine as a recommended destination for those who love new experiences.

faq.a: The reserved dinner cannot canceled, rescheduled, or transferred to third parties for any other reason but bad weather conditions. 230.name: Dubai Crocodile Park
230.description: Experience the thrill and wonder of Dubai Crocodile Park, a unique wildlife park that offers a captivating glimpse into the world of crocodiles. Located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, this park is one of the largest crocodile parks in the Middle East and is home to a diverse collection of crocodiles, reptiles, and other animals from around the world. Step into the park and be mesmerized by the impressive collection of crocodiles, including the world's largest crocodile, King Croc, a 5.2-meter-long saltwater crocodile. Get up close and personal with these fascinating creatures as you observe their behaviors, habitats, and learn about their importance in the ecosystem. But Dubai Crocodile Park is not just about crocodiles. Explore the park's various exhibits and discover a variety of other reptiles and animals, including snakes, lizards, and birds. Immerse yourself in the educational displays that provide insights into the different species and their natural habitats. For an even more thrilling experience, witness the crocodile feeding shows, where you can see these powerful predators in action. Marvel at their strength and agility as they devour their prey. If you're feeling adventurous, embark on a zip-lining adventure that takes you over the crocodile enclosure, providing a unique and exhilarating perspective on these amazing creatures. Dubai Crocodile Park is not only a place of excitement and adventure but also a center for education and conservation. The park aims to raise awareness about the importance of crocodile conservation and protection. Throughout the park, you'll find educational panels and knowledgeable guides who are passionate about sharing their knowledge and love for these incredible animals. Don't miss the opportunity to visit Dubai Crocodile Park, where you can witness the beauty and power of crocodiles up close. It's an experience that will leave you with a deeper appreciation for these ancient creatures and their place in the natural world.

175.name: Dubai Frame
175.description:
Get ready to witness one of the most iconic landmarks of Dubai from a unique perspective at the Dubai Frame, a stunning architectural marvel that offers breathtaking views of the city's past, present, and future.

Located in the heart of Dubai, the Dubai Frame stands tall at 150 meters and is one of the world's largest picture frames. As you step inside, you'll be transported to a journey through time, starting with the city's humble beginnings as a fishing village to its current status as a thriving metropolis.

Take a panoramic elevator to the top and marvel at the stunning views of Dubai's skyline, with landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall in sight. As you descend, you'll be transported to the future, with projections of what the city might look like in the years to come.

In addition to the stunning views, the Dubai Frame also features interactive exhibits that showcase the city's rich history, culture, and achievements. You'll also get to witness the world's largest picture frame from the inside, with glass panels on either side giving you a unique perspective on the city below.

Perfect for families, couples, and tourists, the Dubai Frame is a must-visit attraction that combines history, culture, and modern technology in a fun and interactive way. So why wait? Book your tickets now and get ready to witness Dubai from a whole new perspective at the Dubai Frame.

176.name: Dubai Garden Glow
176.description:
Dubai’s most magical attraction is back, and it's more breathtaking than ever. Dubai Garden Glow opens its gates with an entirely new concept, offering "2 Experiences at 1 Destination."

All-New Concept Features the Interactive Dinosaur Park and the Enchanting Fantasy Park, Offering a Must-Visit Family Destination at New Location at Zabeel Park Gate-3, next to Dubai Frame.

This Season Dubai Garden Glow introduces an all-new concepts, inviting visitors to explore the thrilling, prehistoric world of Dinosaur Park and the vibrant, artistic world of Fantasy Park all in one location.

It's an all-new theme park designed for more engagement, more amazement, and more unforgettable moments for visitors of all ages. This is the perfect family destination and the must-visit spot in Dubai this season.

faq.q: What is Dubai Garden Glow?
faq.a: A captivating nighttime attraction in Zabeel Park, Dubai, featuring illuminated art installations, realistic dinosaur models, and interactive art exhibits across various themed sections.

faq.q: Where is it located?
faq.a: In the heart of Dubai, within Zabeel Park, easily accessible by public and private transportation.

faq.q: What attractions can I expect inside the garden?
faq.a: The Glow Park with its eco-friendly light art, the educational Dinosaur Park, the creatively recycled Art Park, and the illusion-filled Magic Park.

faq.q: What are the opening hours?
faq.a: The park typically opens in the late afternoon and closes at night.

faq.q: Are there any age restrictions for entry?
faq.a: The park is a family-friendly destination, welcoming visitors of all ages with no age restrictions.

faq.q: Can I bring outside food?
faq.a: Visitors are encouraged to enjoy the variety of food available within the park, as outside food is not permitted.

faq.q: Is there parking available?
faq.a: Yes, there is ample parking available, including dedicated spaces for visitors with disabilities.

faq.q: Are pets allowed?

Dubai Mall Lake Ride

  • Unmatched close-up views of the Dubai Fountain
  • Stunning Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai skyline
  • Ideal for couples, families, and photographers

185.name: Dubai Miracle Garden
185.description:
Get ready to be enchanted by the stunning floral wonderland that is the Dubai Miracle Garden, a one-of-a-kind attraction that boasts over 45 million blooming flowers in a spectacular display of color and creativity.

Located in the heart of Dubai, the Miracle Garden is the world's largest flower garden and features a variety of unique designs and structures, including an impressive flower clock, a heart-shaped pathway, and a magnificent floral castle.

You'll also get to see the Guinness World Record for the largest flower arrangement in the shape of an Airbus A380.

With over 60 different species of flowers on display, including rare and exotic varieties, the Dubai Miracle Garden is a must-visit attraction for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts. From vibrant petunias and marigolds to delicate roses and orchids, the garden offers a stunning display of color and fragrance that is sure to leave you in awe.

In addition to the breathtaking displays, the Dubai Miracle Garden also features a range of attractions, such as a butterfly garden, a trampoline park, and a miniature train ride, making it the perfect destination for families and groups.

So why wait? Book your tickets now and get ready to immerse yourself in a world of color and beauty at the Dubai Miracle Garden, a true wonderland of floral creativity and imagination.

faq.q: WHAT IS THE DUBAI MIRACLE GARDEN?
faq.a: Dubai Miracle Garden is the world’s largest natural flower garden, showcasing over 150 million flowers in various artistic designs and patterns, spread across a vast area.

faq.q: WHEN IS THE BEST TIME TO VISIT THE DUBAI MIRACLE GARDEN?
faq.a: The ideal time to visit the Dubai Miracle Garden is between October and February. The garden operates from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM on weekdays and 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM on weekends.

faq.q: WHAT ATTRACTIONS CAN I EXPECT INSIDE THE GARDEN?
faq.a: Apart from the vast floral displays, visitors can explore the Dubai Butterfly Garden, the 15-meter floral clock, the Smurfs’ Village, the Emirates A380 floral structure, and the amphitheatre for live events.

faq.q: ARE THERE ANY DRESS CODE REQUIREMENTS?
faq.a: Visitors are advised to wear comfortable clothing suitable for a public family destination. There are no strict dress code requirements, but modest attire is recommended.

faq.q: CAN I BRING OUTSIDE FOOD AND BEVERAGES?
faq.a: No, outside food and beverages are not allowed inside the garden. However, there are dining options available within the premises.

faq.q: ARE THERE ANY ITEMS PROHIBITED INSIDE THE GARDEN?
faq.a: Yes, items like scooters, bicycles, hoverboards, and pets are not allowed inside the garden.

faq.q: IS THE DUBAI BUTTERFLY GARDEN PART OF THE MIRACLE GARDEN TICKET?
faq.a: The Dubai Butterfly Garden is located adjacent to the Miracle Garden and offers a unique experience with thousands of butterflies. It may require a separate ticket or be included in certain combo offers.

faq.q: HOW CAN I BUY TICKETS FOR THE DUBAI MIRACLE GARDEN?
faq.a: Tickets can be purchased online through our website for a seamless and contactless experience. We recommend online booking to avoid long queues.

faq.q: ARE THERE ANY FACILITIES FOR VISITORS INSIDE THE GARDEN?
faq.a: Yes, the garden offers various facilities like dining options, souvenir shops, designated seating areas, and restrooms for the convenience of visitors.

148.name: Dubai Safari Park
148.description:
Embark on a wild adventure at the Dubai Safari Park, a premier wildlife destination located in the heart of Dubai that offers a unique and unforgettable experience for visitors of all ages.

Spread over 119 hectares, the Dubai Safari Park features over 3,000 animals from all over the world, including lions, tigers, giraffes, zebras, and many more. With a focus on conservation and education, the park offers a range of experiences that allow visitors to learn about the animals and their habitats in a fun and interactive way.

From guided safaris and animal encounters to educational programs and shows, the Dubai Safari Park offers something for everyone. You can explore the park by foot or by vehicle, with options ranging from the African safari to the Asian and Arabian villages.

In addition to the animal attractions, the park also features a range of entertainment options, including a dinosaur park, a butterfly garden, and a petting zoo, making it the perfect destination for families, couples, and groups.

With its focus on conservation, education, and fun, the Dubai Safari Park is a must-visit attraction that offers a unique and unforgettable experience for animal lovers and adventure seekers alike.

So why wait? Book your tickets now and get ready to experience the wild side of Dubai at the Dubai Safari Park.

227.name: Dubai Water Canal Dhow Cruise
227.description:
Spend an evening on the water in the very heart of Dubai.

The cruise follows the Dubai Water Canal — the man-made waterway that links the old Dubai Creek with the Arabian Gulf.

You sail aboard a contemporary dhow with a glass-enclosed hall and an open deck: the mood of the evening is yours to choose.

As the vessel glides past the illuminated promenades, an international buffet is served on board.

The towers of Business Bay, the mirrored waterfall of the Sheikh Zayed Bridge and the silhouette of the Burj Khalifa pass by in turn.

An unhurried pace, accomplished cooking and the finest evening panorama of the city.

What to Expect

  • A contemporary dhow: a traditional-form vessel with a glass-enclosed hall and an open deck.
  • International buffet: mezze and salads, a live pasta station, meat and seafood grills, desserts and beverages.
  • The Dubai Water Canal: a route along illuminated promenades, footbridges and the Marasi Bay marina.
  • Sheikh Zayed Bridge waterfall: Dubai's first sensor-operated waterfall bridge — a striking shot straight from the deck.
  • Business Bay panorama: evening views of the city's business district and the Burj Khalifa from the water.

Perfect For

  • A romantic evening: the lit-up city beyond the panoramic window.
  • A first visit to Dubai: the city's landmark views and dinner in a single programme.
  • Family time: a gentle route, a buffet for every taste and generous deck space.
  • Special occasions: an anniversary, a birthday or a proposal on the water.
  • An evening with La Perle: the cruise can be combined with a ticket to Dubai's signature show.
227.terms:
What's Included

  • Dinner — international buffet (starters, salads, hot dishes, desserts)
  • Live pasta station and grill station

  • Bar menu items are charged separately.
  • Alcoholic beverages are served only to guests aged 21 and over.

Useful Information

  • Cruises operate daily: boarding from 6:15 pm, departure at 7:00 pm, return at 9:30 pm.
  • Advance table reservation is required.
  • The vessel departs strictly on schedule; no refund is issued in case of late arrival.
  • The dress code is smart casual. A light wrap is recommended for the open deck in the evening.
  • Soft beverages are included in the price. Alcohol is ordered from the bar menu and charged separately.
  • The buffet includes vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free dishes.
  • The vessel has an air-conditioned glass-enclosed hall and an open deck; seating is subject to availability.

  • In adverse weather conditions the cruise is rescheduled to another date or the cost is refunded.

Rules & Regulations

  • Outside food or drinks of any kind not allowed.
  • Smoking is only allowed in designated areas.
  • Alcoholic beverages sold only to 21+.

faq.q: What is the dress code?
faq.a: The dress code is smart casual. The open deck can be cool and breezy in the evening, so a light wrap is recommended.

faq.q: How long is the cruise?
faq.a: Boarding begins at 6:15 pm and the cruise runs from 7:00 pm to 9:30 pm. Total time on board is 2 hours 30 minutes.

faq.q: Are children allowed on the cruise?
faq.a: The cruise is suitable for guests of all ages, including families with children. Children under 4 years old travel free of charge. Child rates apply to children aged 4–11 years. Guests aged 12 and above are charged the adult rate.

faq.q: Where is the pier?
faq.a: Boarding takes place at the pier on the Dubai Festival City Waterfront Promenade.

faq.q: Do I need to print my confirmation?
faq.a: Both printed and electronic booking confirmations are accepted.

faq.q: What happens if I arrive late?
faq.a: The vessel leaves the pier strictly at 7:00 pm. Guests arriving late cannot be boarded and no refund is issued.

faq.q: Which beverages are included?
faq.a: Water, soft drinks, tea and coffee are included in the price. Wine, beer, spirits and champagne are ordered from the bar menu and charged separately.

faq.q: Are there vegetarian dishes?
faq.a: Yes. The buffet includes vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free items.

faq.q: Can I choose where I sit?
faq.a: Tables are allocated at the time of booking, either in the air-conditioned glass-enclosed hall or on the open deck. Preferences are accommodated subject to availability.

faq.q: Can the vessel be booked exclusively?
faq.a: Yes. Private events, corporate dinners and celebrations are arranged on request.

faq.q: What happens in bad weather?
faq.a: In adverse weather conditions the cruise may be rescheduled to another date. Where rescheduling is not possible, the cost is refunded.

faq.q: Can the route change?
faq.a: The route and schedule may be adjusted for technical or safety reasons; no refund is provided in such cases.

Visit Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, the largest indoor theme park in the world, awarded by the World Travel Awards. Here you will feel like a real racer!

218.name: Gyrocopter Flight in Dubai
218.description: Take to the skies and experience the thrill of a Gyrocopter Flight over Dubai's iconic sites. This unique aircraft offers a one-of-a-kind experience as you soar through the air at 1,500 ft. With a trusted pilot at the helm, you'll have the opportunity to witness breathtaking views of Dubai's most famous attractions, including Ain Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis, The Palm, The World Islands, and the majestic Burj Al Arab. The standard package includes a 20-minute flight, pictures, and an edited video of the experience. Residents of the UAE can enjoy a special discount of 20% off the price of their flight until September 30, 2023. Please note that this discount is not applicable to gift vouchers. The style of Gyrocopter aircraft used during your flight is at the discretion of the operations team. Pregnant women are not allowed to participate in this experience, and customers flying in open-style Gyrocopters are not permitted to carry any items for safety reasons.

209.name: Helicopter Flight Abu Dhabi
209.description:
Seen from above, Abu Dhabi is a capital where glass skyscrapers sit alongside the turquoise waters of the Persian Gulf and the untouched mangroves of its islands.

The city reveals itself in a whole new way: the Corniche and grand palace complexes give way to the natural landscapes of Al Hudayriat and Reem islands, while the silhouette of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque looks even more majestic from the air.

What to Expect

  • The Corniche and capital landmarks: a bird's-eye view of the waterfront, Marina Mall, Emirates Palace hotel and the Presidential Palace.
  • Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque: the majestic silhouette of Abu Dhabi's most famous landmark, which can only be fully appreciated from above.
  • Islands and mangroves: Al Hudayriat and Reem islands set against the sparkling waters of the Persian Gulf.
  • Record-breaking architecture: the leaning Capital Gate tower and a 123-metre flagpole.
  • Ideal For
  • Special occasions: mark a memorable date with an unforgettable flight over the capital — special birthday and marriage proposal packages are available.
  • First-time visitors and family trips: see Abu Dhabi's top attractions from a completely new angle in just a few minutes.
  • Photography lovers and thrill-seekers: stunning shots and the adrenaline rush of flying high, with professional photography available.

faq.q: What should I wear?
faq.a: The dress code is casual. Hats and scarves are not allowed during the flight.

faq.q: What can I take on board?
faq.a: Only a phone, camera and sunglasses are allowed. Bags, hats and scarves must be left in the storage area at the helipad. Professional cameras with lenses of 400 mm or longer, selfie sticks and tablets are not permitted on board.

faq.q: Are there any weight restrictions?
faq.a: Yes. On shared flights, the weight limit is 110 kg per passenger; passengers over this limit must purchase an additional seat. On private flights, the total weight limit is 450 kg. Seatbelt extenders are not used.

faq.q: Can pregnant women take the flight?
faq.a: Yes, up to the 32nd week of pregnancy. We recommend getting your doctor's approval beforehand.

faq.q: What happens in bad weather?
faq.a: Flights may operate in reduced visibility. If a flight is cancelled due to weather conditions, you will be offered a new date or a refund.

faq.q: Do I need to print my ticket?
faq.a: No, both printed and electronic tickets are accepted.

faq.q: Where is the helipad located?
faq.a: Flights depart from the helipad at Zayed Port in Abu Dhabi.

faq.q: What are the rules for children?
faq.a: Children under 2 are not permitted to fly. Children aged 2 and over require their own seat and pay the full adult fare. Children aged 2–12 must be accompanied by an adult (18 or over).

faq.q: Can I drive the helicopter myself?
faq.a: It is not allowed to fly a helicopter by law.

128.name: Helicopter Flight from Dubai Police Academy by HeliDubai
128.description:
Dubai is a metropolis whose outline changes depending on where you view it from: on the ground, the city impresses with its sheer scale, while from above it reveals itself in a completely different way — as a single composition of glass, sand and sea.

A few minutes in the air, and familiar landmarks come together into one seamless panorama: a city of the future set against desert and ocean, seen the way few people ever get to see it.

What to Expect

  • Flight over the Dubai skyline: take to the skies in a pilot-flown helicopter and enjoy a bird's-eye view of the metropolis.
  • Iconic landmarks: fly over Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah and The World Islands.
  • Contrasting landscapes: golden desert sands and the azure waters of the Persian Gulf in a single flight.
  • Memorable shots: a chance to photograph the city from the air against its most recognisable views.
  • Choice of routes: flights range from 12 to 40 minutes, with different landmarks depending on the option selected.
  • Ideal For
  • Romantic couples: a special occasion and an unforgettable experience for two over the city in the evening.
  • First-time visitors to Dubai: see the emirate's top attractions from a completely new angle in one short flight.
  • Photography lovers: unique shots of the city and coastline from a bird's-eye view.

faq.q: What should I wear?
faq.a: The dress code is casual. Hats and scarves may not be worn during the flight.

faq.q: How long is the flight?
faq.a: The duration depends on the route selected — from 12 to 40 minutes. You need to arrive at the helipad 45 minutes before departure for check-in and the safety briefing.

faq.q: What documents do I need for the flight?
faq.a: Each passenger must present an original passport or Emirates ID (copies and photos are not accepted), as well as a printed or electronic ticket.

faq.q: What can I take on board?
faq.a: Only a phone, camera and sunglasses. Bags, hats and scarves must be left in the storage area.

faq.q: What happens in adverse weather?
faq.a: Flights may operate in reduced visibility. If a flight is cancelled due to weather conditions, you will be offered a new date or a refund.

faq.q: Are there any weight restrictions?
faq.a: Yes. On shared flights, the weight limit is 110 kg per passenger; passengers over this limit must purchase an additional seat, with an absolute maximum of 140 kg. On private flights, the total limit on board is 400 kg. Seatbelt extenders are not permitted.

faq.q: Can pregnant women take the flight?
faq.a: Yes, up to the 32nd week of pregnancy. We recommend getting your doctor's approval beforehand.
