76.name: Helicopter flight from the Palm Island, Dubai
76.description:
Palm Jumeirah is a man-made island shaped like a palm tree and one of Dubai's boldest engineering projects. This is where one of the most spectacular ways to see the city begins — from a bird's-eye view.

Within minutes, the scenery transforms: glittering skyscrapers stand alongside golden desert sands and the turquoise expanse of the Persian Gulf. The panorama unfolds quickly and dramatically, leaving you with the feeling of flying over two different worlds at once.

What to Expect

  • Take-off from Palm Jumeirah: lift off from the helipad at Atlantis The Palm and begin your flight over one of the world's most recognisable islands.
  • Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab: Dubai's iconic silhouettes from a bird's-eye perspective you simply can't get from the ground.
  • The World Islands: fly over a man-made archipelago shaped like a map of the world (on routes of 15 minutes or longer).
  • The coastline and Dubai Marina: views of Jumeirah Beach, Aquaventure Waterpark and the Marina skyscrapers (on extended routes).
  • Memorable shots: stunning photos and videos against the glittering skyline and turquoise waters of the Gulf.
  • Ideal For
  • Special occasions: special birthday and marriage proposal packages are available.
  • First-time visitors to Dubai: a chance to see all of the city's top attractions in one short flight.
  • Thrill-seekers and photography lovers: a unique perspective and an adrenaline rush you can't get on the ground.
76.terms:
What's Included:

  • Helicopter flight (duration depends on the option selected, from 12 to 60 minutes)
  • Check-in and safety briefing
  • Passenger insurance in line with UAE General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) requirements

Additional Services:
Available at an extra cost:

  • Professional photos
  • Special package (birthday, marriage proposal, etc.)
  • Private transfer to and from the helipad

Restrictions:

  • Sharing flight: up to 110 kg per passenger. If exceeded, an additional seat must be purchased
  • Private flight: total limit of 450 kg
  • Seat belt extenders are not provided
  • Children under 2 years are not permitted on the flight
  • From the age of 2, a child occupies a separate seat and pays the full adult fare
  • Children aged 2 to 12 must be accompanied by an adult (18+)

faq.q: What should I wear?
faq.a: The dress code is casual; hats and scarves may not be worn during the flight.

faq.q: Where is the helipad located?
faq.a: Flights depart from the helipad on Palm Jumeirah, next to Atlantis The Palm.

faq.q: How early should I arrive before departure?
faq.a: Check-in opens 45 minutes before departure — please arrive in good time to complete the safety briefing. Late arrivals may be denied boarding without a refund.

faq.q: Do I need to print my ticket?
faq.a: No, both printed and electronic tickets are accepted.

faq.q: Can I bring food and drinks?
faq.a: No, food and drinks are not allowed on board.

faq.q: What can I take on board?
faq.a: You may bring only your smartphone, camera and sunglasses — bags, hats and scarves must be left in the storage area before the flight.

faq.q: What happens in bad weather?
faq.a: Flights may operate in reduced visibility. If a flight is cancelled due to weather conditions, you will be offered a new date or a refund.

faq.q: Can pregnant women take the flight?
faq.a: Yes, up to the 32nd week of pregnancy; we recommend getting your doctor's approval beforehand.

faq.q: Are there any weight restrictions?
faq.a: Yes: on shared flights, the limit is 110 kg per passenger, and passengers over this limit must purchase an additional seat. On private flights, the total limit is 450 kg; seatbelt extenders are not permitted.

faq.q: What are the rules for children?
faq.a: Children under 2 are not permitted to fly. From the age of 2, a child requires their own seat and pays the full adult fare; children aged 2–12 must be accompanied by an adult (18+).

faq.q: What types of tickets are available?
faq.a: Flights are priced by duration. Available options are 12, 15, 17 and 25 minute flights. The longer flights will include more sights.

faq.q: Can tickets be refunded or changed?
faq.a: Tickets are fully refundable 7 days or more prior to the flight, and 50% refundable 4 days or more prior to the flight. No Refunds can be provided for cancellations within 3 days of the booked flight. Flights can be rescheduled up to 24 hours free of charge.

faq.q: Do I need any special preparations before my flight?
faq.a: We recommend wearing comfortable clothing and shoes. Sunglasses are advisable for daytime flights. Otherwise, just bring your excitement and camera to capture the views!

faq.q: Are there Age restrictions?
faq.a: Children 2 years old or younger are not allowed to fly.

faq.q: Can people of determination fly?
faq.a: Yes! As long as passenger can sit in the seat in a regular seated position, then they are welcome to fly.

faq.q: Is Photography allowed?
faq.a: Guests are welcome to take photos once the flight has begun, but photos are not allowed prior to boarding the aircraft.

2645.name: Heritage Cultural Retreat: Overnight Safari with Hot Air Balloon
2645.description:
The Heritage Cultural Retreat joins the best of Platinum Heritage in one journey: an evening of Bedouin culture in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a night in a stone dwelling, and a sunrise flight in a hot air balloon over the dunes.

The first day brings a vintage Land Rover or camel nature drive, a falcon show at sunset, a traditional dinner and Emirati performances under the stars. Before dawn you travel to the balloon site, float for 45 to 60 minutes above the desert, and land for a breakfast inspired by the four elements beside a quiet oasis on royal grounds.

What to expect

  • Nature drive or camel caravan: 60 minutes through the reserve with a Conservation Guide, in a 1950s Land Rover or by camel.
  • Falconry at sunset: a live display of the birds that shaped Bedouin life.
  • Bedouin evening: coffee roasting, fresh Ragag bread, camel rides, a four-course dinner and interactive Emirati performances.
  • Stone dwelling night: a quiet night in a traditional room built from natural materials.
  • Sunrise balloon flight: 45 to 60 minutes above the dunes as the sun comes up.
  • Oasis breakfast: a gourmet breakfast on royal grounds after landing.

Perfect for

  • Couples and honeymooners: a sunrise flight and a calm night in the desert make a special occasion.
  • Bucket-list travellers: the full Dubai desert story in one trip: culture, wildlife and the view from the sky.
  • Families with older children: children from 7 years can fly; children 7-11 pay the child rate.
2645.terms:
What's included:

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off in Dubai (shared air-conditioned vehicle, or private car if booked)
  • Headscarf and stainless steel water bottle to keep
  • 60-minute nature drive in a vintage Land Rover, or a camel caravan (by option)
  • Sunset falconry show
  • Four-course traditional dinner and cultural entertainment
  • Overnight stay in a stone dwelling room
  • 45-60 minute sunrise hot air balloon flight
  • Gourmet breakfast in a desert oasis

Not included:

  • Tips and personal expenses

Optional extras:

  • Private car for your group
  • Transfers from Sharjah, Ajman, Abu Dhabi, Fujairah or Ras Al Khaimah

faq.q: What is the minimum age?
faq.a: 7 years, because of the balloon flight. Children aged 7-11 pay the child rate.

faq.q: What happens if the balloon cannot fly?
faq.a: The pilots decide on the morning, for safety. You get a new date for the flight or a partial refund.

faq.q: How long is the balloon flight?
faq.a: 45 to 60 minutes, at sunrise.

faq.q: When does it operate?
faq.a: Every day from 1 November to 30 April.

faq.q: What should I wear?
faq.a: Light, comfortable clothes, a hat, sunglasses and sunscreen. From November to March bring a warm layer for the evening and the early morning.

faq.q: Can you cater for special diets?
faq.a: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and kosher-style meals are possible. Tell us about diets and allergies when you book.

2646.name: Heritage Morning Safari: Bedouin Culture
2646.description:
Start the day the way the Bedouin did. On this morning safari in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve you travel by camel to a traditional village, meet the falconer and his birds, and sit down to a real Emirati breakfast.

Conservation Guides tell the story of desert life and heritage, young locals invite you to join a traditional dance, and the morning ends with a 60-minute nature drive in a vintage Land Rover, the first motor vehicle in the UAE. You are back at your hotel before lunch.

What to expect

  • Camel caravan: a 15-minute ride to the Bedouin village; two guests share each camel.
  • Bedouin village: tents, cooking stations and farm animals, and a live Arabic coffee demonstration.
  • Falcon encounter: meet a falcon up close, talk to the falconer and take photos.
  • Emirati breakfast: Balaleet, Chabab pancakes, Ragag bread, local cheese with dates and more.
  • Al Rafza dance: join young locals in a traditional celebratory performance.
  • Vintage Land Rover drive: 60 minutes through the reserve looking for oryx and gazelles.

Perfect for

  • Families: gentle, hands-on activities, with a child rate for ages 5-11 and a family pass for 2 adults and 2 children.
  • Early risers: cool morning air, soft light for photos and the afternoon free.
  • Culture lovers: an authentic look at Emirati traditions, food and music.

  • Headscarf and stainless steel water bottle to keep
  • 15-minute camel caravan
  • Bedouin village visit and falcon encounter
  • Traditional Emirati breakfast with hot and cold drinks
  • Cultural activities and dance
  • 60-minute nature drive in a vintage Land Rover

Not included:

faq.a: Yes. Children 5-11 pay the child rate, and a family pass covers 2 adults and 2 children. Children under 5 need a private car.

faq.q: How long is the camel ride?
faq.a: About 15 minutes. Two guests share one camel.

faq.q: When does it operate?
faq.a: Every day from 1 November to 30 April.

faq.q: Who should not join the nature drive?
faq.a: The drive is not recommended for guests who are more than six months pregnant.

faq.q: Does the tour support conservation?
faq.a: Yes. A part of every booking goes to conservation work in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve.

163.name: Heritage Safari
163.description:
We invite you to experience the authentic traditions of the Emiratis and embark on a journey "back in time" on retro 1950s Land Rovers in the largest ecological park in Dubai, Al Marmoom.

Here you can observe wild sand gazelles and white oryx antelopes grazing in their natural desert habitat. 

To enhance the desert experience, you will have the opportunity to take a camel ride, also known as the "ships of the desert", near a Bedouin camp. Dinner will be served in traditional local style with authentic dishes and beverages.

itinerary.name: Arrival at Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve
itinerary.desc: Enter the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a protected area that covers 225 square kilometers of the country's desert ecosystem. This reserve is a testament to Dubai's commitment to preserving its unique environment. Here, you'll witness a pristine stretch of desert landscape, home to many species of wildlife and plants.

itinerary.name: 60-minute Nature Safari
itinerary.desc: Board a 4x4 vehicle driven by an experienced desert guide. Over the next hour, traverse the undulating dunes and valleys, known as "wadis". Keep an eye out for native wildlife like the Arabian Oryx, gazelles, and various bird species. Your guide will share insights about the desert's ecology, the survival techniques of its inhabitants, and the history of the region.

itinerary.name: Falconry Show at Sunset
itinerary.desc: As the sun begins to set, casting a golden hue over the dunes, gather to witness the ancient art of falconry. Watch in awe as these magnificent birds of prey demonstrate their hunting skills, diving and swooping at incredible speeds. Learn about the significance of falconry in Bedouin culture and its importance in the UAE's heritage.

itinerary.name: Transfer to the Camp
itinerary.desc: After the falconry show, you'll be transferred to a traditional desert camp. The camp is designed to replicate the Bedouin lifestyle, complete with tents, cushions, and carpets.

itinerary.name: Camel Riding
itinerary.desc: Experience the desert as the Bedouins have for centuries - on the back of a camel. These 'ships of the desert' offer a unique vantage point, allowing you to feel the rhythm of the desert and connect with its vastness.

itinerary.name: Traditional Bread and Coffee Making Demonstration
itinerary.desc: Discover the culinary traditions of the Bedouin people. Participate in a demonstration on how to make traditional Arabic bread and coffee. Taste the freshly made bread, and sip on the aromatic coffee, known as "Gahwa", often flavored with cardamom.

itinerary.name: Traditional 4-course Dinner
itinerary.desc: As the evening progresses, indulge in a sumptuous 4-course dinner. The menu typically includes a variety of salads, grilled meats, traditional dishes like hummus and tabbouleh, and delectable desserts. Enjoy your meal under the starlit desert sky.

itinerary.name: Cultural Show
itinerary.desc: Post-dinner, immerse yourself in the rich cultural performances of the region. The evening's entertainment includes an authentic drumming performance, setting the rhythm for the night. This is followed by the Yola dance, a traditional Emirati dance that involves performers twirling long sticks, showcasing their agility and coordination.

74.name: Hot Air Ballon Flight in Dubai
74.description:
Experience the magic of flight with our Hot Air Balloon Flight in Dubai. This unforgettable adventure takes you soaring above the stunning Dubai landscape, offering breathtaking views of the desert and the majestic Hajar mountains. 

Our Hot Air Balloon Flight in Dubai is more than just a ride; it's an experience that will leave you feeling inspired and rejuvenated. As you float peacefully above the desert, you'll be captivated by the beauty of the sunrise, the vastness of the landscape, and the tranquility of the moment. 

We offer a variety of flight packages to suit all preferences. Our deluxe sunrise flights are a popular choice, allowing you to watch the sunrise over the mountains while soaring through the sky. If you're looking for a romantic getaway or a unique proposal idea, our private flights are perfect for you. 

Our experienced pilots are trained to provide a safe and enjoyable flight for all passengers. They will guide you through the skies, pointing out landmarks and sharing their knowledge of the area. We also happen to be the only company in the world offering an industry rare in-flight falcon show with all our packages. 

Our state-of-the-art hot air balloons are regularly maintained to ensure they meet the highest safety standards. They are equipped with the latest technology to ensure a comfortable and smooth ride. 

In addition to our standard flights, we also offer custom packages for corporate events, weddings, and other special occasions. Our team will work with you to create a unique experience that will be unforgettable for all. 

Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for a new experience, our Hot Air Balloon Flight in Dubai is the perfect adventure. Book now and secure a lifetime experience with us!

IMG Worlds of Adventure – Dubai's Mega Indoor Theme Park

The world's largest indoor theme park, bringing Marvel superheroes, cartoon favourites, and life-sized dinosaurs under one giant roof.

faq.a: Tickets can be purchased online through our website or at the ticket counters at the park entrance. We recommend buying tickets online to ensure availability and to take advantage of any online-exclusive deals.

faq.q: Are there any age or height restrictions for the rides?

faq.q: What are the park's opening hours?

faq.q: Is there a dress code for the park?

faq.q: Is parking available at the park?

faq.q: Can I re-enter the park if I leave during the day?

470.name: Jet Ski Burj Al Arab
470.description:
Experience Highlights

  • ​Sail Past a Global Icon: Cruise directly by the iconic silhouette of the Burj Al Arab, a true beacon of architectural luxury.
  • ​Marvel at the Palm Coastline: Glide along the pristine shores of the expansive Palm Jumeirah, taking in the impressive scale of this man-made wonder.
  • ​Admire Modern Architecture: Take in the imposing and spectacular designs of the Royal Atlantis and the Atlantis resorts.
  • ​Feel the Coastal Energy: Dash across the shimmering waters framing the vibrant and bustling Jumeirah Beach Residence district.
  • ​Cruise Alongside a Masterpiece: Glide past Ain Dubai, an engineering marvel and the planet's tallest observation wheel.

​What to Expect

​Forget ordinary, passive excursions. This adventure places you firmly in the driver’s seat of a potent jet ski, allowing you to slice through the deep blue waves of the Arabian Gulf. As you navigate the waters, Dubai’s world-famous monuments provide a dramatic, towering horizon. It is the ultimate fusion of high-octane adrenaline and unparalleled sightseeing, designed for those who want to feel the rush of speed while collecting unforgettable visual memories.

Perfect For

  • ​Adrenaline Enthusiasts: Ideal for anyone craving a fast-paced, action-packed marine adventure.
  • ​Sightseers with a Twist: A phenomenal choice for newcomers seeking an unconventional, thrilling way to explore the city.
  • ​Content Creators & Photographers: Tailor-made for those on the hunt for spectacular, unobstructed angles of legendary landmarks.

64.name: LEGOLAND Dubai Theme Park
64.description:
LEGOLAND Dubai is a unique LEGO theme park suitable for families with children. LEGOLAND Dubai has more than 40 attractions, 15,000 different figures assembled from 60 million LEGO cubes. The park offers six themed areas with entertainment and educational games: 

  • LEGO CITY - here children can fly in a LEGO City airport plane, drive a boat on their own and get their first driver's license. 
  • KINGDOMS - young guests can step into the role of princes and princesses, have a breathtaking adventure through the castle of a king, full of unique items of medieval life, created from LEGO bricks. 
  • IMAGINATION - LEGO lovers can spend an unforgettable time creating their figures from LEGO cubes, racing LEGO cars or attending classes at the LEGO Academy, Master Builder Academy. 
  • ADVENTURE - here young adventurers can take a ride on a submarine, take part in water races, as well as search for stolen treasure of Pharaoh. 
  • MINILAND - in the heart of LEGOLAND Dubai, LEGO cities of the world were created out of 20 million LEGO cubes. 
  • FACTORY - you can learn how LEGO cubes are created and get a LEGO cube right from the conveyor belt. There is also the BIG Shop - the largest LEGO store in the Middle East.

212.name: Lost World Aquarium
212.description:
Explore the vibrant marine wonderland of the Lost World Aquarium in Dubai and immerse yourself in the beauty of the underwater world. Designed to transport you to a lost civilization beneath the waves, this aquarium is a must-visit attraction for marine enthusiasts and families alike. 

Observe the daily feeding sessions, where trained divers hand-feed the aquatic creatures, providing a unique spectacle. It offers interactive experiences that allow you to get up close and personal with some of the marine inhabitants. Visit the touch pools and have an amazing interactive experience with fascinating sea creatures. Gain valuable insights into marine conservation and the importance of preserving underwater ecosystems.  Book your Lost World Aquarium tickets now and embark on a journey to discover the wonders of the underwater world. It's an experience that will leave you with lasting memories.

faq.q: WHAT ARE THE OPENING HOURS OF THE LOST CHAMBERS AQUARIUM?
faq.a: The aquarium is open daily from 10 AM to 10 PM. Last admission is typically an hour before closing.

faq.q: CAN I PURCHASE TICKETS ON ARRIVAL OR SHOULD I BOOK IN ADVANCE?
faq.a: While tickets can be purchased on arrival, we recommend booking in advance through our website to ensure availability and to take advantage of any online discounts or special offers.

faq.q: ARE THERE ANY AGE RESTRICTIONS FOR VISITORS?
faq.a: The Lost Chambers Aquarium is suitable for all ages. However, children under the age of 12 must be accompanied by an adult. Certain activities like diving may have age and health restrictions.

faq.q: IS PHOTOGRAPHY ALLOWED INSIDE THE AQUARIUM?
faq.a: Yes, photography for personal use is allowed and encouraged. However, flash photography is prohibited as it can disturb the marine life.

faq.q: ARE THERE DINING FACILITIES WITHIN THE AQUARIUM?
faq.a: While there are no dining facilities inside the aquarium, there are multiple dining options available within close proximity in Atlantis, The Palm.

faq.q: IS THE LOST CHAMBERS AQUARIUM WHEELCHAIR ACCESSIBLE?
faq.a: Yes, the aquarium is fully accessible for wheelchair users. Wheelchairs are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

faq.q: IS THERE PARKING AVAILABLE AT THE LOST CHAMBERS AQUARIUM?
faq.a: Yes, there is ample parking available at Atlantis, The Palm, which is where the Lost Chambers Aquarium is located.

faq.q: CAN I CANCEL OR RESCHEDULE MY TICKETS?
faq.a: Tickets are non-refundable.

Capture memorable photos and selfies surrounded by stunning underwater backdrops.

157.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
157.description:
Step into the Louvre Abu Dhabi, the Arab world’s first universal museum and a symbol of cultural dialogue and exchange. Located in the Saadiyat Cultural District, this landmark institution showcases a curated journey through humanity’s artistic heritage, spanning ancient civilizations to modern innovation.

With 9,200 square metres of display space, the museum’s permanent collection is enriched by loans from renowned French institutions such as the Musée du Louvre, Musée d'Orsay, and Centre Pompidou. Temporary exhibitions add fresh perspectives throughout the year. Visitors are invited to explore the shared threads between global cultures, presented in a way that transcends borders, timelines, and traditions.

Designed by acclaimed architect Jean Nouvel, the museum is a work of art in itself. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the building is crowned with a monumental dome composed of 7,850 interlaced stars. This floating canopy filters sunlight to create a stunning “rain of light,” casting intricate shadows across the open spaces below.

Surrounded by the waters of the Arabian Gulf, Louvre Abu Dhabi offers a serene and immersive environment to admire artistic treasures from across the world. From ancient relics to contemporary masterpieces, the museum celebrates the richness of human creativity across time and place.

180.name: Madame Tussauds Dubai
180.description:
Get ready to rub shoulders with the stars at Madame Tussauds Dubai, an iconic and world-renowned wax museum that offers a one-of-a-kind celebrity experience.

Located in the heart of the city, Madame Tussauds Dubai features over 60 lifelike wax figures of some of the world's most famous celebrities, including Hollywood stars, musicians, sports icons, and world leaders.

From taking selfies with your favorite celebrities to experiencing the thrill of being on stage with your favorite musicians, Madame Tussauds offers a range of interactive experiences that allow visitors to get up close and personal with their idols.

In addition to the wax figures, Madame Tussauds also features a range of entertainment options, including interactive exhibits, themed zones, and photo opportunities, making it the perfect destination for families, couples, and groups.

With its focus on fun, entertainment, and celebrity culture, Madame Tussauds Dubai is a must-visit attraction that offers a unique and unforgettable experience for visitors of all ages.

So why wait? Book your tickets now and get ready to step into the glamorous world of celebrity at Madame Tussauds Dubai.

65.name: Motion Gate Dubai Theme Park
65.description:
MOTIONGATE Dubai is the largest Hollywood theme park in the Middle East, bringing together three legendary film studios - Sony Pictures Studios, DreamWorks Animation and Lionsgate. You will have a unique opportunity to be on the other side of the screen and plunge into the magical world of Hollywood movies. 

In the Sony Pictures Studios area you can hunt for ghosts, ride the Black Beauty of the Green Hornet, ride the High Speed Chase roller coaster, and the bravest can climb the Blast Off 58 meter high freefall tower in Zombieland.

In the Smurf Village, a warm welcome awaits you in the Smurfs' mushroom houses and five attractions, including the world's first roller coaster based on the cartoon Smurfs. The fully indoor DreamWorks area features 12 rides, including a roller coaster, dungeon, and interactive areas, plus five live-action areas.

You can visit characters from Shrek, Kung Fu Panda, Madagascar and How to Tame the Dragon. In the Lionsgate area you can ride rides based on the world-famous Hunger Games movie, including a roller coaster and a 3D simulator.

34.name: Musandam Day Trip
34.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey with our Musandam Day Trip, a tour that promises to immerse you in the stunning beauty of the Musandam Peninsula, the northernmost part of the Sultanate of Oman.

This tour is perfect for those who are passionate about breath-taking scenery, pre-historic mountains, and a rich underwater world.

Your adventure begins in Dibba, a small town on the Musandam peninsula, where you will board a traditional Arabic 'dhow' and sail northwards. As you sail, you will witness tiny villages nestled between the mountains and the sea. You will have the opportunity to snorkel in beautiful coves and if you're lucky, you might even get to race alongside dolphins in one of the bays.

On your return journey, you will have the chance to try your hand at line fishing, and who knows, you might even catch a barracuda. This day trip is sure to provide you with countless stories to share with your friends about your adventure in the land of the fjords.

The tour includes pick up from Dubai between 8.00 - 9.00 AM. Please note that if you are staying in other Emirates, you will need to contact us for a custom quote. For shared trips, pick-ups can only be done from hotels.

The tour package includes a 5-hour cruise in Musandam, biscuits, dates & fresh fruits, lunch onboard, towels & sunbeds onboard, water, tea, coffee, soft drinks, snorkelling & hand-line fishing. 

The Musandam Day Trip is not just a tour, it's an experience that will leave you with memories to cherish for a lifetime. Book your trip with us today and let us take you on an adventure you will never forget.

210.name: National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
210.description:
Immerse yourself in the wonders of the underwater world at the National Aquarium Abu Dhabi.

As the largest aquarium in the Middle East, it is home to over 46,000 marine animals from more than 300 unique species. Explore the ten nautically-themed zones, each offering a different glimpse into the diverse marine life found in the region and beyond.

From the UAE's Natural Treasures to sunken sea wrecks and Atlantic caves, you'll be captivated by the beauty and diversity of the underwater world. Marvel at the vibrant coral reefs, encounter majestic sharks and rays, and discover rare and exotic species that you've never seen before.

The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi goes beyond just showcasing marine life. It offers engaging and interactive experiences that allow visitors to fully immerse themselves in the marine environment. Take a glass-bottom dhow tour and get a unique perspective of the underwater world. Get up close and personal with sharks, puffins, and freshwater rays during personal animal encounters.

Learn about the vital role the marine environment plays in our wellbeing through innovative video mapping technology and signage guides. Whether you're a marine enthusiast, a family looking for a fun and educational outing, or simply someone who appreciates the beauty of nature, the National Aquarium Abu Dhabi is a must-visit destination. Experience the magic of the underwater world and create memories that will last a lifetime.

301.name: Natural History Museum, Abu-Dhabi
301.description:
Located in the iconic Saadiyat Cultural District, the Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi invites visitors on an extraordinary journey through time -  from the origins of the universe to the richness of life on Earth and the natural heritage of the Arabian Peninsula.

Designed by the award-winning architectural studio Mecanoo, the museum spans 35,000 sqm and features a striking form inspired by desert rock formations and the elemental patterns of life. Inside, breathtaking galleries bring together rare meteorites, exceptional dinosaur fossils -  including the world-famous Tyrannosaurus rex “Stan”  -  and immersive recreations of Abu Dhabi’s prehistoric landscapes.

More than a cultural landmark, the museum is a global centre for discovery and scientific advancement. Its state-of-the-art research facilities support pioneering work in palaeontology, biodiversity, marine science, and earth sciences.

Through interactive exhibitions, family programmes, workshops, and community-science initiatives, the Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi inspires curiosity, sparks imagination, and encourages visitors of all ages to engage with the natural world and envision a more sustainable future.

Discover the story of life - shaped by the past, designed for the future.

What to expect

  • Galleries: rare meteorites and exceptional dinosaur fossils, including the world-famous Tyrannosaurus rex “Stan”.
  • Architecture: a striking 35,000 sqm building by Mecanoo, inspired by desert rock formations and the elemental patterns of life.
  • Prehistoric landscapes: immersive recreations of Abu Dhabi’s ancient natural heritage.
  • Science hub: state-of-the-art research facilities supporting work in paleontology, biodiversity, marine science, and earth sciences.
  • Interactive programmes: family activities, workshops and community-science initiatives for all ages.

Perfect for

  • Families with children: interactive galleries and hands-on activities suitable for all ages.
  • Science and nature enthusiasts: rare fossils, meteorites, and cutting-edge research displays.
  • Culture and architecture lovers: a striking building by Mecanoo in the heart of the Saadiyat Cultural District.
  • Curious minds of all ages: immersive storytelling about the origins of life and the universe.

2644.name: Overnight Desert Safari with Stone Dwelling Stay
2644.description:
Spend a full evening and a night in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, far from the lights of the city. The afternoon starts with a 60-minute nature drive in a vintage 1950s Land Rover, or a slow camel caravan across the dunes, with a Conservation Guide who explains how plants, animals and the Bedouin survive in the desert.

After a falconry show at sunset you arrive at a torch-lit Bedouin camp for dinner and Emirati entertainment. When the camp goes quiet, you sleep in a traditional stone dwelling room under a sky full of stars, and wake up to a gourmet breakfast before the transfer back to Dubai.

What to expect

  • Nature drive or camel caravan: 60 minutes through the reserve in a vintage Land Rover, or the same journey by camel, with a Conservation Guide.
  • Sunset falconry: a live falcon display against the desert sunset.
  • Bedouin camp: Arabic coffee and dates on arrival, live bread and coffee making, camel rides, henna and shisha.

234.name: Private Fujairah City Tour from Fujairah
234.description:
Fujairah's east coast reveals a different side of the UAE — one where the rugged Hajar Mountains meet the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Oman, far from the glass towers of Dubai.

Here centuries-old heritage sits quietly beside the present day: an ancient mosque still used for prayer, a fortress that once guarded mountain trade routes, and an elegant modern mosque rising nearby as a symbol of the emirate today.

What awaits you

  • Al Bidya Mosque: the UAE's oldest mosque — four domes resting on a single internal column, preserved since the 15th century.
  • Khorfakkan Waterfall: a picturesque man-made waterfall by the corniche amphitheatre, a popular photo spot.
  • Al Rafisah Dam: an artificial lake framed by the Hajar Mountains, ideal for scenic photos.
  • Fujairah Fort: a historic fortress with massive walls, telling the story of the emirate's past.
  • Sheikh Zayed Mosque: an elegant modern complex and one of Fujairah's landmark buildings.

Perfect for

  • Nature and photography lovers: mountains, a lake and a waterfall in one route.
  • History and culture lovers: the UAE's oldest mosque and a centuries-old fort.
  • First-time visitors to the east coast: Fujairah's main sights covered in a single day.

2650.name: Private Night Safari and Astronomy
2650.description:
See the desert when it comes to life after dark. Your private car and Conservation Guide take you into the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve for a 60-minute night drive in a 1950s Land Rover, followed by a guided eco-walk with torches and UV lights to find sandfish, scorpions and other night creatures.

At a peaceful, torch-lit oasis on royal desert grounds you join other guests for Arabic coffee, a close look at desert owls and a three-course dinner. The evening ends with an astronomy session at a telescope and stories of how the Bedouin used the stars to find their way. You can add a night in a stone dwelling and a sunrise balloon flight.

What to expect

  • Private night drive: 60 minutes in a vintage Land Rover with your own guide.
  • Nocturnal eco-walk: search for desert wildlife with torches and UV lights.
  • Owl encounter: learn about desert owls and see them up close.
  • Three-course dinner: Emirati and grill dishes cooked fresh on site.
  • Astronomy session: the moon, planets and constellations through a telescope, with an expert.
  • Options: a night in a stone dwelling with breakfast, and a sunrise hot air balloon flight (November to April).

Perfect for

  • Couples: a private, romantic evening under the stars.
  • Families: children love the night walk, the owls and the telescope.
  • Curious travellers: a different side of the desert, far from the busy safari camps.

181.name: Qasr Al Watan, Royal Palace
181.description:
Step into the world of royalty and history at Qasr Al Watan, an iconic palace and cultural landmark located in Abu Dhabi.

Built to showcase the rich heritage and culture of the United Arab Emirates, Qasr Al Watan is a grand and majestic palace that boasts stunning architecture, intricate design, and luxurious interiors.

Inside, visitors can explore the various rooms and halls of the palace, each of which is adorned with beautiful art, calligraphy, and traditional crafts. The palace also houses an extensive collection of historical artifacts, manuscripts, and documents, providing a unique insight into the history and culture of the UAE.

In addition to the exhibits, Qasr Al Watan also offers a range of interactive experiences, including cultural workshops, traditional performances, and guided tours, allowing visitors to learn about the customs, traditions, and values of the Emirati people.

With its focus on culture, heritage, and education, Qasr Al Watan is a must-visit attraction for anyone looking to experience the beauty and grandeur of the UAE's rich history and culture.

So why wait? Book your tickets now and get ready to step into the world of royalty and history at Qasr Al Watan.

233.name: Ras Al Khaimah City Tour
233.description:
Ras Al Khaimah is one of the oldest continuously inhabited corners of the Arabian Peninsula, where centuries of history sit alongside the rugged grandeur of the Hajar Mountains.

This sightseeing tour is an unhurried introduction to the country’s northernmost emirate: its past, its traditions and its calm character, which sets it noticeably apart from modern Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

What awaits you

  • Al Qawasim Corniche: view the historic waterfront once used by pearl divers, fishermen and traders.
  • Old Town: wander through the district that reflects the emirate's cultural heritage.
  • National Museum (Al Hisn Fort): explore exhibits on seafaring and pearl-diving history inside the former royal residence.
  • Dhayah Fort: climb to a legendary hilltop fortress with panoramic views of mountains, palm oases and the coast.

Perfect for

  • History and culture lovers: forts, museums and the region's pearl-trading legacy.
  • Photography enthusiasts: waterfronts, mountains and coastal panoramas throughout the day.

2648.name: Royal Falconry Training & Nature Safari
2648.description:
Falcons have been part of Emirati life for centuries. On this private morning experience a professional falconer shows you how falcons, hawks and owls are trained, and how the birds hunt with ancient and modern techniques.

During the 75-minute interactive session a bird lands on your glove, a moment of real trust between you and the falcon. Then a luxurious Land Rover Defender takes you on a nature drive through the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, past a remote lake, to a gourmet breakfast at the famous Al Maha Desert Resort & Spa.

What to expect

  • Private falconry session: 75 minutes with an expert falconer in a desert camp, with falcons, hawks and owls.
  • Bird on your glove: hold a bird of prey and learn how it is cared for and trained.
  • Ethical approach: the birds' health and welfare always come first.
  • Nature drive: 60 minutes in a Land Rover Defender with a Conservation Guide, with a stop at a remote lake.
  • Breakfast at Al Maha: a chef's breakfast menu on the deck of the resort.

Perfect for

  • Animal lovers: a hands-on, ethical encounter with birds of prey.
  • Private groups: the whole experience is only for your group.
  • Culture seekers: falconry is a UNESCO-listed tradition and a symbol of the UAE.

711.name: Sharing transfer to Dubai Mall from Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah
711.description:
Dubai is the tourism hub of the UAE, where record-breaking shopping malls rise beside opera houses, souqs and the world's tallest tower — a city built on contrast and scale.

For a few hours, the everyday rhythm of another emirate gives way to the buzz of Dubai's biggest names: glass towers overhead, an aquarium behind mall walls, and the choice to explore freely or chart your own course across the city.

What awaits you

  • The Dubai Mall: the world's largest shopping and entertainment center, listed in the Guinness Book of Records, with an aquarium and countless shops.
  • Burj Khalifa and Souq Al Bahar: views of the world's tallest tower and the nearby traditional-style souq and Dubai Opera.
  • Sharing basis: five hours of free time to shop, dine and explore the mall and surrounding landmarks.

Perfect for

  • Guests staying in other emirates: an easy day trip to Dubai without arranging your own transport.
  • Shoppers and families: free time at the world's largest mall, with shops, an aquarium and dining all in one place.

203.name: Shindhaga Museum
203.description:
The Shindagha Museum is an exciting journey through the history and culture of Dubai. Located on the banks of Dubai Creek, this museum complex reveals the rich heritage of the emirate and allows visitors to experience its atmosphere across different eras. 

The museum's exhibitions include interactive displays, artifacts, photographs, and multimedia presentations that tell the stories of traditions, maritime activities, trade, art, and the daily lives of the indigenous population. Key themes include the influence of the Persian Gulf on the region's development, Dubai's role as a trading port, and the transition from village life to a modern metropolis.

222.name: Ski Dubai
222.description: Experience the thrill of skiing in the heart of the desert with our incredible Ski Dubai tour. Located in the Mall of the Emirates, Ski Dubai is the first indoor ski resort in the Middle East and offers a one-of-a-kind experience for winter sports enthusiasts. Step into a winter wonderland as you enter Ski Dubai's massive snow park, which spans over 22,500 square meters. Feel the chill in the air as you explore the various attractions and activities available. Strap on your skis or snowboard and hit the slopes, where you can carve your way down the snowy hills and experience the thrill of winter sports in a unique setting. For those who prefer a more relaxed experience, take a ride on the chairlift and enjoy the breathtaking views of the snow-covered landscape. Marvel at the intricately designed snow sculptures and igloos, and even try your hand at building your own snowman. If you're looking for some family fun, head over to the snow park's tubing hill, where you can slide down the slopes on an inflatable tube. Or, grab a sled and race down the snow-covered hills with your loved ones. After all the excitement, take a break and warm up with a hot chocolate or indulge in some delicious snacks at one of the cozy cafes in the snow park. Don't forget to capture the memories with stunning photos against the backdrop of the snowy landscape. Whether you're a seasoned skier or a beginner looking to try something new, Ski Dubai offers an unforgettable experience for all ages and skill levels. Escape the desert heat and immerse yourself in a winter wonderland like no other.
222.terms:
The price includes:

Access to Ski Dubai's snow park, Ski or snowboard equipment rental, chairlift ride, snow sculptures and igloos, tubing and sledging activities.

Additional services available for an extra fee:

faq.q: Is skiing or snowboarding experience required?
faq.a: No, Ski Dubai caters to all skill levels, from beginners to advanced skiers and snowboarders.

faq.q: Can I bring my own ski or snowboard equipment?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring your own equipment or rent it at Ski Dubai.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age requirement for the snow park?
faq.a: No, the snow park is suitable for all ages.

223.name: Sky Dive Dubai
223.description:
Experience the thrill of a lifetime with our Sky Dive Dubai tour. Soar through the sky and feel the rush of adrenaline as you embark on a breathtaking skydiving adventure in one of the most iconic cities in the world.

As you ascend to the skies, take in the stunning panoramic views of Dubai's magnificent skyline, pristine beaches, and the vast Arabian Gulf. Feel the wind in your hair and the exhilaration in your heart as you freefall from thousands of feet above the ground.

Our experienced and certified instructors will guide you every step of the way, ensuring your safety and providing you with an unforgettable experience. Whether you're a seasoned skydiver or a first-timer, our team will make sure you have the time of your life.

After your thrilling skydive, take a moment to catch your breath and relish in the incredible accomplishment you've just achieved. Share your experience with friends and family as you receive a personalized certificate to commemorate your dive.
223.terms: Participants must be at least 18 years old and in good health to participate in the skydiving experience. Skydiving is subject to weather conditions and may be rescheduled or canceled if deemed unsafe. Participants must sign a waiver before participating in the tour. Refunds will not be provided for cancellations made within 48 hours of the scheduled tour.

faq.q: Is skydiving safe?
faq.a: Skydiving is a thrilling but safe activity when conducted with experienced instructors and proper safety measures in place. Our team of certified instructors will ensure your safety throughout the entire experience.

faq.q: Can I bring my own camera to capture the skydiving experience?
faq.a: For safety reasons, personal cameras or devices are not allowed during the skydiving experience. However, professional photographers will capture stunning photos and videos of your dive, which can be purchased afterward.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is not suitable for skydiving?
faq.a: The safety of our participants is our top priority. If weather conditions are deemed unsafe for skydiving, the tour may be rescheduled or canceled. Participants will be notified in advance and provided with alternative options.

Sky Views Edge Walk is the most thrilling attraction in Dubai and the first of its kind in the region. It is the highest outdoor walkway on a skyscraper, at a height of over 219.5 meters above the ground. This walk takes visitors on the exterior side of the building, without windows or other protective barriers

178.name: Sonara Camp
178.description:
Discover the enchanting Sonara Camp, nestled in the heart of the breathtaking Arabian Desert within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve. Combining luxury with sustainability, Sonara offers an extraordinary dining experience set against an awe-inspiring natural backdrop. Driven by eco-friendly principles, the camp utilizes solar energy, practices zero-waste policies, and sources materials and ingredients ethically, ensuring your visit supports responsible tourism.

Experience the magic of Sonara Camp at sunset. A short drive across the dunes will take you to a cozy lounge with panoramic desert views, where refreshing drinks and light bites are served to the sounds of ambient music. Guests can enjoy a variety of activities: sandboarding, volleyball, soft archery, a camel ride, and a captivating falcon show – a true symbol of Arabian culture.

In the evening, Sonara Camp transforms into an enchanting dining destination among the dunes. Your journey begins with a scenic desert drive, setting the tone for a magical night. At the camp, indulge in a refined seasonal menu crafted by the chef, inspired by the rich flavors of local cuisine. Entertainment awaits guests of all ages: sandboarding, volleyball, and archery, while the evening comes alive with a falconry show, fire performance, music, and for children – a movie under the stars.

Choose your perfect Sonara experience: Sunset, Dinner, or the ultimate combination of both.

Sonara Camp promises more than just a dinner – it’s an extraordinary adventure connecting you deeply with nature, culture, and unforgettable desert hospitality.

182.name: Speed Boat Tour Dubai
182.description:
Experience the thrill of the open sea and the breathtaking sights of Dubai with our Rib Boat Experience. This 90-minute guided sightseeing tour is the perfect way to explore the city's iconic landmarks from a unique perspective. 

Your journey begins at the Dubai Marina, where you'll board our state-of-the-art Rib Boat. Our experienced captain and crew will ensure your safety and comfort throughout the tour. As we set sail, you'll be treated to a red carpet departure, a symbol of the luxury and exclusivity of this experience.

The tour takes you past some of Dubai's most famous attractions. Marvel at the Marina Skyline, a testament to the city's architectural prowess. Witness the grandeur of Ain Wheel, the world's largest observation wheel. Be awed by the Atlantis The Palm, a majestic 5-star hotel situated on the Palm, a man-made island. And of course, no tour of Dubai would be complete without a view of the Burj Al Arab, the world's most luxurious hotel.

Our Rib Boat Experience is not just about sightseeing. It's also about the thrill of the ride. Feel the adrenaline rush as the boat speeds up to 30-35 knots. But don't worry, there will be plenty of opportunities for photo ops. Our boat will make stopovers at each attraction, giving you the chance to capture these stunning sights with the perfect backdrop.

Join us for the Rib Boat Experience and discover Dubai like never before!
182.terms:
Price includes:

  • Briefing
  • 90-minute water excursion
  • Photo stops at major attractions:

   - Dubai Marina

   - Ain Dubai Ferris Wheel

   - Atlantis Hotel

   - Burj Al Arab Hotel

  • Transfer (in case of choosing the option with transfer)
     

The tour is prohibited for persons with heart diseases, neck or back problems, as well as pregnant women in their second and third trimesters

265.name: TeamLab Phenomena
265.description:
TeamLab Phenomena in Abu Dhabi is an immersive art experience that showcases the innovative work of the Tokyo-based art collective, teamLab. The exhibition, which opened in 2023, is part of the broader vision to create a cultural hub in the UAE, blending art with technology to engage audiences in unique and interactive ways.


Spanning over 17,000 square feet, the exhibition features a series of immersive installations that emphasize the relationship between nature and digital art. Visitors are invited to step into a series of vibrant, moving landscapes where the lines between reality and digital art blur. The installations are designed to be experiential and interactive, allowing guests to engage with the art directly. For instance, as participants walk through these spaces, their movements influence the artwork, creating a dynamic experience that changes in real-time.


One of the hallmark features of TeamLab Phenomena is its focus on collaboration and interconnectedness. The artworks often respond to the presence of viewers, encouraging social interaction and collective participation. This aspect speaks to belief in the importance of human connections in a fast-paced digital age, making the exhibition not just a visual feast, but also a community experience.


The exhibitions often draw inspiration from natural elements, such as water, light, and flora, resulting in stunning visual displays that highlight both the beauty of the natural world and the capabilities of advanced technology. The use of projection mapping, sensors, and augmented reality creates immersive environments that captivate the senses, encouraging visitors to explore deeply and interactively.


TeamLab’s philosophy is anchored in transcending traditional boundaries of art by combining science, technology, and art. This approach invites discussions about the future of art and the impact of technology on human experiences. The teamLab collective operates on a concept they call “Borderless,” which emphasizes the idea that art should not have physical boundaries or restrictions.


Abu Dhabi's hosting of TeamLab Phenomena represents a significant addition to its cultural landscape, aligning with the city's vision to promote creativity and innovation. It connects international cultural movements with local audiences, fostering a greater appreciation for contemporary art forms among visitors and residents alike.


Overall, TeamLab Phenomena in Abu Dhabi is not just an art exhibition; it’s a transformative experience that challenges visitors to think about their relationship with art, technology, and one another. It exemplifies how contemporary exhibits can create spaces for reflection, engagement, and togetherness in an increasingly digital world. Whether you’re an art aficionado or a casual visitor, TeamLab Phenomena promises to be an enriching experience that leaves a lasting impression.

faq.q: What is TeamLab Phenomena?
faq.a: TeamLab Phenomena is an immersive art exhibition created by the Tokyo-based art collective, teamLab. It features a series of interactive, digital artworks that merge technology with nature, allowing visitors to engage with the art through movement and interaction. The exhibition aims to create a unique environment that fosters connections between visitors and the artwork.

faq.q: Where is TeamLab Phenomena located?
faq.a: TeamLab Phenomena is located in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It is part of the city’s efforts to establish a vibrant cultural scene and is accessible to both local residents and international visitors.

faq.q: How long does it take to experience the exhibition?
faq.a: The time it takes to experience TeamLab Phenomena can vary based on individual preferences. On average, visitors can spend between one to two hours exploring the various installations and engaging with the interactive elements. Guests are encouraged to take their time to fully appreciate the immersive environment.

faq.q: Are children allowed in the exhibition?
faq.a: Yes, TeamLab Phenomena is suitable for visitors of all ages, including children. The interactive nature of the exhibition makes it a fun and engaging experience for families. However, parental supervision is recommended to ensure safety and assistance in navigating the displays.

faq.q: How can I purchase tickets for TeamLab Phenomena?
faq.a: Tickets for TeamLab Phenomena can typically be purchased online through the official exhibition website or at the venue's ticketing counter. It is recommended to book tickets in advance, especially during peak visiting times, to ensure availability and avoid long queues.

116.name: The Green Planet
116.description:
The Green Planet is an amazing oasis, a true tropical forest in the midst of the desert, a beautiful place for reconnecting with nature. 

The foundation of everything is a gigantic tree, around which a multitude of plants, fish, animals, and birds are located on several levels. They can be seen within arm's reach. The animals and birds freely move around the park. Cute sugar gliders, sloths, cheerful monkeys, wide-eyed lorikeets, colorful parrots, and many other inhabitants are waiting to greet little explorers and their parents.

The monorail connects the Palm Jumeirah to the mainland, with a planned further extension to the Red Line of the Dubai Metro. The line opened on April 30, 2009. It is the first monorail in the Middle East Destination First Train Last Train Gateway 9:00 AM 9:45 PM Atlantis 9:15 AM 10:00 PM

139.description:
You can see the famous palm island at a glance from the height of the 52nd floor of The Palm Tower.

From a height of 240 m, a breathtaking view of the Persian Gulf, the man-made island and the skyscrapers of Dubai opens up.

A three-minute elevator ride is accompanied by a virtual show: at first, its walls seem to become transparent, and then there is an illusion of diving into the depths of the sea.

The 'View Exhibition', is an installation dedicated showing the construction of The Palm Jumeirah.

204.name: Vintage G-Class Evening Heritage Safari at Al Marmoom
204.description:
As the afternoon heat fades, the Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve turns gold — the largest unfenced reserve in the UAE, where ghaf trees, oryx and gazelles share the dunes with a quiet oasis.

You cross it the classic way: in an open-top vintage Mercedes G-Class, the wind in your face and the sand stretching to the horizon, before the evening slows down to the pace of Bedouin life.

What to expect

  • Vintage G-Class drive: a 30-40 minute ride through the reserve in an open-top classic 4x4, with a guide who points out desert plants and wildlife.
  • Camel caravan: a short ride across the dunes at sunset, guided by Bedouin handlers.
  • Falconry show: watch a live falcon display and take a photo with the bird on your arm.
  • Bedouin welcome: Arabic coffee, dates and sweets in a traditional village, with henna painting and live cooking.
  • Five-course dinner under the stars: a set Bedouin menu from the Michelin Bib Gourmand Al Khayma Heritage Restaurant.
  • Stargazing: finish the night at the telescopes and learn how Bedouins used the stars to cross the desert.

Perfect for

  • Couples: a calm, romantic desert evening without the noise of a dune-bashing camp.
  • Families: gentle activities and a real look at Emirati heritage.
  • Photographers: vintage cars, camels, falcons and sunset light in one evening.

What's included:

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off in Dubai (air-conditioned vehicle)
  • 30-40 minute vintage G-Class drive
  • Entry to Al Marmoom Oasis
  • Camel caravan ride

  • Falcon show
  • Henna painting
  • Bedouin entertainment
  • Unlimited water and soft drinks
  • Five-course Bedouin set dinner
  • Stargazing session

Not included:

Optional extras:

  • Book pick-up from Al Maha, Bab Al Shams, Sports City, Motor City, DIP and Jebel Ali
  • Book a private car

faq.a: Comfortable, casual clothes and closed shoes such as trainers. Bring a warm layer from November to March, and sunglasses.

faq.q: Can children join?
faq.a: Yes. Children 4-11 pay the child rate and children under 4 join free. Children under 12 do not ride the camels alone; an adult stays with them.

faq.q: Who should not join?
faq.a: Pregnant women, guests with back or neck problems and wheelchair users.

faq.q: Is the return transfer included?
faq.a: Yes, the drop-off at your hotel in Dubai is part of the tour.

faq.q: Can I drive the G-Class?
faq.a: No, a licensed driver-guide drives the vehicle.

447.name: Wakeboarding from Dubai Marina
447.description:
The High-Energy & Action-Packed Adventure!

  • ​This adventure is fueled by adrenaline, athleticism, speed, and the thrill of catching massive air.
  • ​Defy Gravity: High-Velocity Wakeboarding in Dubai Bluewaters, JBR and Palm Jumeirah island

​Are you ready to push your limits and feel the ultimate rush?

  • Strap in and power up for an adrenaline-fueled wakeboarding session in one of the most jaw-dropping watersports arenas on the planet. Launching from Dubai Marina, we head straight out to the open, glassy waters where speed and progression take center stage.
  • ​Lock into your bindings, grip the handle, and feel the raw power as the boat accelerates.
  • Wakeboarding is a high-energy, full-body workout where you use the boat's massive wake as a launchpad for spectacular jumps and air tricks.
  • Charge across the wake with Bluewaters Island reflecting on the water, blast past the cheering crowds of JBR, and edge hard toward the iconic crescent of Palm Jumeirah.

    ​The Vibe: High adrenaline, explosive speed, and extreme action.

    ​Perfect For:

  • Thrill-seekers, snowboarders or skateboarders looking to transfer their skills to the water, and riders focused on athletic progression, flips, and big air.
  • ​Exclusive Highlight: High-performance specialized wake-boats equipped with precision ballast systems to shape the perfect, crisp wake required for massive pops, technical spins, and smooth landings.

  • This adventure focuses on style, relaxation, effortless riding, and premium content creation against Dubai’s iconic skyline.

162.name: Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi Theme Park
162.description:
Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi is one of the world's largest indoor theme parks. The area of the park is more than 150,000 square meters, includes six zones: Warner Bros Plaza, Bedrock, Dynamite Gulch, Cartoon Junction, Gotham City, Metropolis. The park has more than 25 modern attractions for the whole family, as well as many interactive activities. The park is dedicated to movie characters and cartoons from the famous Warner Brothers Hollywood Studios. You will meet your favorite and brave heroes: Superman and Batman, funny characters from animated series - Tom and Jerry, Bugs Bunny, Scooby-Doo and the Flintstones family, as well as legends from Warner Bros.
There are restaurants, stores, and cafes throughout the park where you'll have a great time!

61.name: Wild Wadi Waterpark
61.description:
Unforgettable aquatic adventure at Dubais original water park!

Inspired by the legendary voyages of Sinbad the Sailor, the park spans over 5 hectares and features more than 25 water slides and attractions, including the mesmerizing 18-meter Wadi Wash waterfall that dazzles with light and music.

Wild Wadi has one of the world's tallest water slides at a staggering 32 meters high! Brace yourself for the ultimate rush as you descend in specially designed capsules at speeds of up to 80 km/h and experience the thrill of free fall. For those who prefer to catch a wave, our 1.5-meter high waves are perfect for surfing.

With so much excitement packed into one place, Wild Wadi water park promises to be a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Don't miss out on the opportunity to create unforgettable memories with family and friends.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks into the park?
faq.a: Outside food and drinks are not permitted inside the park, with the exception of baby food and essential dietary items. There is a variety of dining options available inside the park to cater to your needs.

faq.q: Child policy
faq.a:
Children under 2 years old are free of charge 

Children below 1.1 meters in height need a child ticket

Above 1.1 meters - adult ticket

Some slides have height restrictions for visitors


For Toddlers, there is a specially designated area for play and swimming called Juha's Dhow and Lagoon


Toddlers  must wear swimming arm bands and diapers

faq.q: Can I refund my ticket?
faq.a: Tickets are not refundable.

faq.q: What are the opening hours of Wild Wadi Waterpark?
faq.a: The park's opening hours vary by season. Typically, we open at 10:00 AM and close at 6:00 PM. For the most accurate opening hours, please check our website or contact customer service.

faq.q: Are there any height or age restrictions for the rides?
faq.a: Yes, some rides have height and age restrictions for safety reasons. These restrictions are listed on our website and at the entrance of each ride.

faq.q: What amenities are available inside the park?
faq.a: Wild Wadi Waterpark offers locker rentals, towel rentals, multiple dining options, and gift shops. Additionally, there are relaxation areas and cabanas available for rent.

faq.q: Is parking available at the park?
faq.a: Yes, we offer free parking for guests. Parking spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Dive into a world of splash-tastic adventure at Yas Waterworld, the Middle East’s iconic waterpark destination located on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. 302.name: Zayed National Museum, Abu Dhabi
302.description:
Zayed National Museum in Abu Dhabi is dedicated to honoring the legacy and vision of Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the founding father of the United Arab Emirates.

The museum aims to educate visitors about the rich cultural heritage, history, and achievements of the UAE. Its design features an iconic architectural structure inspired by the desert landscape and traditional Emirati elements.

Inside, visitors can explore immersive exhibits that showcase the nation’s journey from its early days to its current status as a modern, vibrant country. Interactive displays and educational programs engage diverse audiences and promote a deeper understanding of Emirati culture and values.

The museum also highlights Sheikh Zayed’s commitment to environmental sustainability and conservation efforts. Located in the Saadiyat Cultural District, Zayed National Museum is poised to be a cultural landmark, attracting both residents and tourists who seek to learn about the UAE’s history and heritage.
